items.title: EU made-in-China car cap flashes amber warning
items.author: Katrina Hamlin
items.creator: Katrina Hamlin
items.summary: The bloc wants Beijing to limit imports of plug-in hybrids to 15% of market share, the FT reports. It echoes a 1980s deal with Japanese carmakers but lacks the same bite. Still, as Brussels' patchwork of policies grows, Chinese exporters' rapid acceleration into Europe may stall.
items.body:
The bloc wants Beijing to limit imports of plug-in hybrids to 15% of market share, the FT reports. It echoes a 1980s deal with Japanese carmakers but lacks the same bite. Still, as Brussels' patchwork of policies grows, Chinese exporters' rapid acceleration into Europe may stall.
Full view will be published shortly.
Follow Katrina Hamlin on Bluesky and Linkedin .
CONTEXT NEWS The European Union has requested China voluntarily cap exports of hybrid cars at 15% of market share in the bloc, the Financial Times reported on September 17, citing three people familiar with the situation.
China-made hybrids account for about a third of the EU market now, per the report. In 2025, Chinese-made cars accounted for 12% of the bloc’s plug-in electric car sales, according to the European Automobile Manufacturers’ Association.

items.title: サッカー＝エムバペ、インフルエンザ様症状で代表の練習欠席
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２２日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２２日　ロイター］ - サッカーのフランス代表主将キリアン・エムバペが２２日、インフルエンザに似た症状が出たことにより代表練習を欠席した。フランス・サッカー連盟（ＦＦＦ）が明らかにした。直近に控える欧州ネーションズリーグでの出場に不透明感が出ている。

レアル・マドリード（スペイン）に所属するエムバペは代表のトレーニング拠点に残り、他の選手は練習に参加した。

この日はジネディーヌ・ジダン新監督の下で２回目の練習となった。フランスは２５日に敵地でトルコと対戦するが、ジダン監督にとっては代表指揮官としての初陣となる。

フランスは今回の代表活動期間中、ベルギーとホーム、アウェーで対戦するほか、イタリアもホームに迎える予定。

items.title: サッカー＝アルテタ監督、アーセナルとの新契約で合意─報道
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２２日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２２日　ロイター］ - サッカーのイングランド・プレミアリーグ、昨季王者のアーセナルがミケル・アルテタ監督（４４）と条件面を改善した新契約に合意した。同監督の契約は今季で満了の予定だった。英ＢＢＣが２２日に報じた。

アルテタ監督は２０１９年にアーセナルの指揮官に就任すると、チームの改革に着手。３年連続でリーグ２位フィニッシュとなった後、昨季ついに２２年ぶりの優勝を手にした。ジョシュ・クロンキ共同会長は今年５月、アルテタ監督の残留がクラブの最優先事項と話していた。

今季のアーセナルは連覇に向けて好調なスタートを切っており、リーグ開幕から４連勝。１９日のブライトン戦で０─３と敗れたが、５試合を終えて２位につけている。

items.title: X-rays negative for Braves RF Ronald Acuna Jr. (shin)
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Atlanta Braves right fielder Ronald Acuna Jr. left Tuesday's game against the Cincinnati Reds in the third inning with a left shin contusion.
items.body:
Atlanta Braves right fielder Ronald Acuna Jr. left Tuesday's game against the Cincinnati Reds in the third inning with a left shin contusion.
Facing Reds left-hander Brandon Williamson, Acuna swung at an inside cutter and fouled the ball off his left shin, below the knee and just above a protective guard.
Acuna appeared to be in agony as the trainer attended to him, but he eventually walked off the field into the clubhouse for X-rays that proved negative. The Braves announced he is day-to-day.
Pinch hitter Brewer Hicklen inherited Acuna's count and popped out to third, then took over in right field.
Acuna has missed two lengthy stretches of this season due to leg injuries, but the four-time All-Star has heated up down the stretch. In his last 23 games starting Aug. 28, Acuna has batted .368 with a .429 on-base percentage and .678 slugging percentage. That includes seven homers and 20 RBIs in 98 plate appearances.
For the year, Acuna owns a slash line of .259/.352/.462 with 20 homers and 20 stolen bases in 104 games.
The Braves (92-64) entered Tuesday's play four games behind the Los Angeles Dodgers (96-60) for the National League's No. 2 seed and a first-round bye, so Acuna likely will be given time to heal before returning to the lineup with an eye toward being healthy for the postseason.
--Field Level Media

items.title: ＭＬＢ＝ヤンキースのジャッジ、ＷＣシリーズ欠場濃厚
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２２日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２２日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）ヤンキースの主将アーロン・ジャッジ外野手（３４）が、宿敵レッドソックスとのア・リーグのワイルドカード（ＷＣ）シリーズを欠場する可能性が高いことが分かった。

アーロン・ブーン監督は２２日、ジャッジについて「出場しないことを前提に考えている」と明らかにした。

ヤンキースは１９日、右ふくらはぎを痛めたジャッジを１０日間の負傷者リスト（ＩＬ）に登録。ブーン監督はけがの程度を「中程度」と説明しており、ジャッジは２１日の休養日に患部へ乏血小板血漿（ＰＰＰ）注射を受けたという。

ジャッジは肋骨のけがで今季３カ月以上離脱し、今月８日に復帰。復帰後は２３打数４安打の打率１割７分４厘、１本塁打、３打点、１３三振だった。今季は６６試合に出場し、打率２割４分１厘、１８本塁打、４１打点。

オールスター選出８回で、リーグ最優秀選手（ＭＶＰ）に３度輝いている。２０１６年のメジャーデビューからヤンキース一筋で、通算１２１１試合出場、打率２割９分１厘、３８６本塁打、８７１打点を記録している。

２２日時点では、ヤンキースが第４シード、レッドソックスが第５シードとして、２９日からヤンキースの本拠地で３試合制のＷＣシリーズを戦う組み合わせとなっている。

items.title: India's trading tweaks target the wrong problem
items.author: Shritama Bose, Hudson Lockett
items.creator: Shritama Bose, Hudson Lockett
items.summary: Regulators may water down a new system that calculates end-of-day share prices after volatility spiked in the $5 trln stock market. But that would ignore the key lesson earlier adopters like Hong Kong learned: that boosting liquidity, while hard, is a more durable solution.
items.body:
India's $5 trillion equity market risks turning into a global outlier. Regulators are considering whether a spike in volatility warrants watering down a new system that calculates end-of-day share prices. Doing so would appease local brokers, but it represents a short-term fix at best and backsliding on necessary reform at worst.
In August, India became one of the few remaining major stock markets in the world to switch from continuous trading to the closing auction session (CAS), a mechanism to determine share prices at the end of each trading day. Thin trader participation caused sharp price swings, triggering pushback from brokers and a review of the new system by the Securities and Exchange Board of India.
That might ring a bell for those who traded on Hong Kong Exchanges almost two decades ago. The bourse rolled back CAS within 10 months of introducing it in 2008 after an 11% flash crash in HSBC (0005.HK) shares. The Indian watchdog hasn't pulled the plug yet, and chief Tuhin Kanta Pandey on September 10 said CAS is "here to stay". Yet proposals SEBI made in a consultation paper released days later could effectively dismantle it.
To reduce price uncertainty on days when derivative contracts expire, SEBI is asking market participants to choose one of two options. The first would determine closing prices by blending trades from the last 30 minutes of normal trading with the 10-minute closing auction. The other is to revert for at least a year to using only the last 30 minutes of normal trading on its own to generate settlement prices, ditching CAS altogether.
Taking either of those routes would represent pussyfooting on a market reform that's crucial for index funds to avoid tracking errors when indexes rebalance. It would also dent the Indian equity market's ambition to be counted among the best-in-class globally, its vaunted digital infrastructure and legions of local investors notwithstanding.
And, as HKEX's reintroduction of CAS in 2016 shows, a transition is inevitable as passive funds extend their dominance. Rather than diluting closing auctions, regulators could consider a more aggressive drive to maximise their liquidity. They are moving in that direction by relaxing hedging rules for arbitrage funds, as Bloomberg reported on Wednesday, citing unnamed sources.
They could go further by pushing large local asset managers to increase auction participation; that ought to appeal as their net asset values adjust daily, giving them a stake in effective price discovery. A temporary transaction-tax waiver on CAS trades for market makers would help, too.
SEBI's framework for closing auctions already incorporates key lessons from the Hong Kong experience, including a transparent reference price band and random closing times to minimise manipulation. It can go one better over its Asian peer by keeping the pedal to the metal on reforms instead of slamming them into reverse.
Follow Shritama Bose on LinkedIn and X .
The Securities and Exchange Board of India on September 12 proposed a review of how settlement prices for equity index and stock derivatives are determined on expiry day.
The markets regulator laid out two options to tweak the newly launched Closing Auction Session in a consultation paper. The first is to blend trades from the last 30 minutes of normal trading with the 10-minute closing auction to yield the settlement price. The second entails going back to using only the last 30 minutes of normal trading, de-linking derivatives settlement prices from CAS altogether, at least for a year.
The proposals are open to public feedback until October 3.

items.title: Solar, baterías y redes eléctricas: dónde invertir en clima ante auge de la IA y altas tasas
items.author: Ishika Mookerjee
items.summary: Según gestores de fondos centrados en el medio ambiente, la energía solar en tejados, el almacenamiento de baterías y las empresas de servicios públicos europeas figuran entre las áreas de interés.
items.body: Bloomberg — Las empresas de ingeniería solar de EE.UU. y las tecnologías de mitigación de incendios forestales están emergiendo como las inversiones preferidas ligadas al clima antes de la Semana del Clima en la Ciudad de Nueva York. Según cinco gestores de fondos centrados en el medio ambiente entrevistados por Bloomberg News , la energía solar en tejados, el almacenamiento de baterías y las empresas de servicios públicos europeas son otras áreas de interés ante el aumento de la demanda energética, a pesar de las persistentes preocupaciones del mercado sobre la inflación y el futuro de la inteligencia artificial. En conjunto, estos gestores administran alrededor de US$7.500 millones. Ver más: Trump impone aranceles del 15% a paneles solares y polisilicio importado “El suministro eléctrico se ha convertido en un importante obstáculo, no solo para nuestro crecimiento digital, sino también para su descarbonización, por lo que la demanda de experiencia y soluciones también está aumentando”, afirmó Katie Self, gestora de inversiones de Pictet Asset Management. Sus recomendaciones llegan en un momento de gran turbulencia para los precios de las acciones. Si bien el índice S&P Global Clean Energy Transition se mantiene aproximadamente un 63% por encima del mínimo de los últimos cinco años alcanzado en abril de 2025, ha perdido más de una quinta parte de su valor en los últimos cuatro meses. Esto ocurre a pesar de que la inversión en energías renovables fuera de China alcanzó los US$247.000 millones en el primer semestre de 2026, un 15% más que el año anterior y a punto de batir un récord, según BloombergNEF . La actual debilidad del mercado está ligada a las presiones inflacionarias causadas en gran medida por la guerra en Irán, lo que llevó a la Reserva Federal a tomar la decisión la semana pasada de subir las tasas de interés por primera vez desde julio de 2023. Al mismo tiempo, las empresas relacionadas con la IA se enfrentan a un mayor escrutinio a medida que aumentan las dudas sobre los posibles daños sociales de esta tecnología. “La reciente caída en las acciones de empresas relacionadas con la IA ha reducido significativamente los múltiplos en el sector de las energías limpias, a pesar de un mercado muy sólido para la infraestructura energética”, dijo Ulrik Fugmann, gestor de cartera de BNP Paribas Asset Management. Ver más: La millonaria oportunidad que tiene América Latina al reciclar paneles solares, baterías y aerogeneradores Esto es lo que dijeron los gestores de fondos sobre lo que significa el contexto actual del mercado para las acciones de energía limpia, y cómo los inversores podrían encontrar los aspectos positivos en un entorno de mercado volátil. A pesar de la agenda a favor de los combustibles fósiles del presidente Donald Trump, algunos gestores de fondos siguen siendo optimistas sobre las perspectivas de la industria solar, ya que Estados Unidos busca añadir nuevas fuentes de electricidad para satisfacer las necesidades energéticas de los centros de datos, y cada vez más empresas trasladan su producción al país para evitar los aranceles de Trump. Las cifras les favorecen: la energía solar y el almacenamiento en baterías representan el 70% de la capacidad total de generación eléctrica añadida en el primer semestre de 2026. Según estimaciones recopiladas por Bloomberg , las empresas incluidas en el índice de Barclays Plc sobre la industria solar estadounidense registrarán un crecimiento de beneficios del 28% en los próximos 12 meses. A pesar de estas estadísticas, el índice de energía solar de UBS ha caído cerca de un 18% este año. Seth Kirkham, director de inversiones en renta variable global de Galvanize, apuesta por el sector a través de las empresas de ingeniería, adquisición y construcción que instalan parques solares. Solv Energy Inc., que diseña proyectos a gran escala y de almacenamiento de baterías, figura entre sus acciones preferidas. “Se están produciendo avances muy significativos en automatización y robótica en el desarrollo y la instalación de parques solares”, afirmó. “Pero, mientras tanto, es fundamental contar con la experiencia necesaria para construir estas grandes infraestructuras”. Para Fugmann, de BNP, la oportunidad va más allá de los paneles solares. Ve potencial en los sistemas de seguimiento y otras tecnologías que pueden mejorar la rentabilidad de los proyectos al reducir los costos de construcción y mantenimiento de las plantas solares. También está explorando inversiones en sistemas solares y de almacenamiento de baterías diseñados para alimentar mini centros de datos para hogares y empresas. Entre las empresas líderes del sector en estas áreas de negocio se encuentran compañías como Sunrun Inc. y Array Technologies Inc. Ver más: ONU pide a empresas de IA reducir emisiones de gases de efecto invernadero ante creciente consumo de energía “Estamos presenciando un desarrollo muy agresivo de la capacidad solar en Estados Unidos que probablemente superará las estimaciones de la mayoría”, dijo Fugmann. La guerra en Irán ha acelerado los proyectos de energías renovables y almacenamiento de baterías en más de 10 países, incluidos Filipinas y Tailandia, mientras los gobiernos lidian con la escasez de energía y el petróleo cotizando cerca de los US$100 por barril. Esto ha vuelto a poner el foco en la seguridad energética. Kirkham afirmó que observa “importantes conjuntos de baterías adyacentes o en otros puntos de la red, lo que está solucionando el problema de la intermitencia y permitiendo a los países —desde la perspectiva de la seguridad del suministro— reducir su dependencia de socios poco fiables en los mercados tradicionales de combustibles fósiles”. El gestor de fondos afirmó que Contemporary Amperex Technology Ltd., un fabricante chino líder de baterías, “se convertirá en una de las empresas más importantes del mundo”. Sin embargo, las acciones de CATL cayeron más del 7% en Hong Kong la semana pasada en medio de la especulación del mercado sobre los recortes de producción de septiembre y una posible disminución en el beneficio neto unitario del tercer trimestre, a medida que más empresas se suman al sector de las baterías. A pesar de la presión competitiva, la rentabilidad del almacenamiento de baterías está mejorando. La adopción global se ve impulsada por la caída del 77% en los precios de las baterías de iones de litio durante la última década, debido a la sobreproducción china, según datos de BloombergNEF , mientras que el proteccionismo favorece la fabricación de baterías en Estados Unidos. “El cambio hacia el almacenamiento de energía en baterías está cobrando mucha fuerza”, dijo Self de Pictet. “Los proyectos solares a gran escala en Europa están incorporando el almacenamiento de energía en baterías como estabilizadores a un ritmo muy, muy rápido”. Jay Koh, cofundador de Lightsmith Group LLC, que administra un fondo de adaptación climática, considera que las empresas que mitigan los riesgos de incendios forestales para los sistemas eléctricos están bien posicionadas para obtener contratos.“Cuando hablamos con las empresas, buscamos dónde está cambiando el gasto, pasando de un gasto reactivo posterior a un desastre a una inversión proactiva en resiliencia”, afirmó. “Los incendios van a ser un gran problema en todas partes”. Según datos recopilados por Bloomberg , el término “fenómenos meteorológicos extremos” ha sido mencionado 409 veces por las 65 empresas que componen un índice global de servicios públicos de S&P en conferencias telefónicas sobre resultados, presentaciones a inversores e informes financieros y ESG este año. Al ritmo actual, se prevé que las menciones superen el máximo anual alcanzado en 2021. Los gobiernos de California, el sur de Europa y Australia —todas ellas regiones con una exposición extrema a los incendios forestales— han introducido nuevas estructuras de financiación destinadas a hacer que las empresas de servicios públicos sean más resilientes. Lightsmith ya ha apostado por los fenómenos meteorológicos extremos. En 2024, invirtió en AiDash Inc., una empresa privada que utiliza inteligencia artificial e imágenes satelitales para ayudar a las compañías eléctricas a gestionar el riesgo de la vegetación, los daños causados por tormentas y las amenazas de incendios forestales. Schneider Electric SE acordó a principios de este año la compra de la empresa por un valor empresarial de US$350 millones. Esta oportunidad también se extiende a las empresas que cotizan en bolsa. Koh considera que las tecnologías de sensores utilizadas en las redes eléctricas, incluidas las líneas de transmisión y distribución, son otro posible beneficiario, dado que las empresas de servicios públicos están invirtiendo más para fortalecer la resiliencia de sus redes. El equipo es suministrado por una amplia gama de proveedores, desde startups y empresas en fase de crecimiento hasta proveedores de infraestructura consolidados como Schneider Electric, ABB Ltd. y Eaton Corp. Self, de Pictet, también destacó otras tecnologías de resiliencia de la red eléctrica, como el soterrado de las líneas de alta tensión. “En Estados Unidos se está debatiendo mucho sobre la posibilidad de soterrar las líneas eléctricas y de servicios públicos”, dijo el inversor. “Es un proyecto con una inversión inicial muy elevada, pero a la larga se obtienen los beneficios de evitar pérdidas en caso de incendios forestales y tormentas”. Según Self, el aumento de los casos de calor extremo no hará sino agravar la necesidad. Ver más: La nueva tecnología limpia a la que Meta y Google están recurriendo para impulsar la IA Cada vez aparecen más centros de datos en toda Europa, justo cuando los reguladores estiman que el sistema de red eléctrica de la región, con 40 años de antigüedad, necesita una inversión de 600.000 millones de euros (US$690.000 millones) hasta 2030 para modernizarse y dar cabida a más energías renovables. Eso convierte a las empresas eléctricas reguladas en una de las principales opciones para Nishant Gupta, fundador de la gestora de fondos de cobertura Kanou Capital LLP, especialmente en el Reino Unido, donde las valoraciones se han quedado rezagadas con respecto a las de Estados Unidos y otros países de Europa. “Dado lo ajustado que está el equilibrio entre la oferta y la demanda de energía aquí, veremos que no solo las empresas de servicios públicos, sino toda la cadena de suministro, tendrán un desempeño excelente”, dijo. A Gupta le gusta la empresa de servicios públicos británica SSE Plc, ya que planea invertir unos US$40.000 millones hasta 2030. “Es una cifra bastante significativa para el tamaño de la empresa, y una parte importante se destinará a energías renovables y redes eléctricas”. También le gusta la empresa francesa SPIE SA, que ayuda a construir redes de transmisión, ya que se beneficia de la demanda de ingenieros. Por otro lado, el gestor de fondos de cobertura está invirtiendo en Wärtsilä Oyj Abp, una empresa finlandesa que fabrica plantas de generación eléctrica de tamaño mediano, con la expectativa de que esta tecnología gane terreno a medida que los centros de datos se vuelvan cada vez más comunes. “Estas empresas instalarán muchas de estas pequeñas plantas de generación eléctrica durante los próximos cinco años”, dijo Gupta. “Y durante los siguientes 20 años, obtendrán negocios de servicios con márgenes muy altos gracias a ellas”. items.title: US to fund $7 billion of Argentina mineral, energy projects, document shows
items.author: Ernest Scheyder, Lucinda Elliott
items.creator: Ernest Scheyder, Lucinda Elliott
items.summary: The US Export-Import Bank plans to fund up to $7 billion worth of critical minerals and energy projects in Argentina, according to a document seen by Reuters, as part of a push to deepen economic cooperation between Washington and Buenos Aires.
items.body:
The US Export-Import Bank plans to fund up to $7 billion worth of critical minerals and energy projects in Argentina, according to a document seen by Reuters, as part of a push to deepen economic cooperation between Washington and Buenos Aires.
The funding is part of a package to be announced in New York on Wednesday during the United Nations General Assembly , a person familiar with the matter said, as the US seeks more access to Western Hemisphere energy and critical minerals.
Under Argentine President Javier Milei, a close ally of US President Donald Trump, ties between Washington and Buenos Aires have deepened through closer alignment on economic policy.
The relationship has been bolstered by US backing for Milei's market-oriented reforms and by a [USN:S0N3YE09L TEXT:"preferential trade"] and investment agreement announced in February that included cooperation on critical minerals. Argentina's Congress has yet to ratify the bilateral deal.
Argentina's presidency did not immediately respond to request for comment.
Argentina has large deposits of lithium, shale oil and other commodities. The US funds will allow companies working in the South American country to receive loans to buy equipment from American manufacturers, among other uses, in the next two years.
Argentina, Chile and Bolivia form the so-called "lithium triangle," concentrating the world's largest supplies of the white metal used in electronics, electric vehicles and other key technologies.
Major commodity companies already operating in Argentina include Rio Tinto (RIO.AX) , which extracts lithium for use in batteries, BHP (BHP.AX) , which is developing a copper project, and Chevron (CVX.N) , which has a large shale oil and gas project.
Milei's government, which faces a presidential election in 2027, has promoted an incentive regime for large investments [USN:S0N41Q009 TEXT:"known as RIGI"], as a cornerstone of efforts to attract foreign capital into strategic sectors including energy, mining and infrastructure.
Italy's Eni (ENI.MI) and Argentina's state-run YPF (YPFDm.BA) submitted a joint application [USN:S0N42K057 TEXT:"last month"] under RIGI for their $51 billion liquefied natural gas project.
Luis Lucero, Argentina's mining minister, earlier this year told Reuters his country could be [USN:S0N40802L TEXT:"exporting"] 580,000 metric tons of lithium and 1,641,000 metric tons of copper annually by 2036, which would be five times higher than 2025 levels.

items.title: マクロン氏、ガザ和平巡りトランプ氏批判　「恥ずべき光景」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
John Irish

[国連 ２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
John Irish

[国連 ２２日 ロイター] - フランスのマクロン大統領は２２日、パレスチナ自治区ガザで和平を実現したとするトランプ米大統領の主張を退け、同地区では人道回廊が一つも再開されていないと述べた。

来年５月に退任するマクロン氏は、国連総会で最後の一般討論演説に臨んだ。その中で、世界は誰もが恥ずべき光景を目の当たりにしていると述べ、トランプ氏がガザ和平計画を外交上の勝利として誇示していることを非難した。 

「１年前、まさにこの議場で十数カ国がパレスチナを国家承認した。『承認は単なる紙切れだ、現実を見よ』という一部の冷笑的な声も耳にする」と拳で演壇をたたきながら述べた。

「しかし、ガザを前に行動しないままでいるなら、われわれにどんな信頼性があるというのか。和平と称するものを誇る者もいる。だが、その和平は１秒たりとも人道支援へのアクセスを再開させていない。われわれ全てが恥じるべきこの光景を、ただ傍観していてよいのか」と問いかけた。

マクロン氏の批判に対し、ホワイトハウスのケリー報道官は「トランプ大統領はイスラエルとイスラム組織ハマスの戦争を終結させ、生存していた人質全員を解放し、死亡した人々の遺体を遺族の元に返し、現在はガザ和平のための２０項目計画の実施を主導している」と反論。「他者が口先だけで論じている間に、大統領はこの複雑な問題に真正面から取り組んだ。この地域の平和と安定のために、これほど尽くした人物は他にいない」と述べた。

items.title: In Cambodia's 'Waiting Village', tattooist mourns trade lost to war
items.author: Chantha Lach
items.creator: Chantha Lach
items.summary: More than 3,000 houses stand in neat rows across Rong Cham, a 400-hectare (990-acre) resettlement site dubbed by residents "the Waiting Village", where families who fled fighting along the Cambodia-Thailand border still wait to return home nine months after the ceasefire.
items.body:
More than 3,000 houses stand in neat rows across Rong Cham, a 400-hectare (990-acre) resettlement site dubbed by residents "the Waiting Village", where families who fled fighting along the Cambodia-Thailand border still wait to return home nine months after the ceasefire.
Among them is Cheng Bora, a tattoo artist known to everyone as Sam, who once ran a thriving shop at Boeung Trakuon, a bustling trade crossing point on the border with Thailand in Cambodia's Banteay Meanchey province.
Now he works from a small house in Rong Cham, dipping his needle into a can of black ink and leaning over a customer to work on his tattoo — one of just a few compared to the number of people he used to get at his home now in the territory controlled by the Thai army since the [USN:L4N3TR1XP TEXT:"border conflict"] last year.
At the Thai border 20 kilometres from the Waiting Village, Sam and his family stopped before a metal barricade marking the edge of accessible territory, trying to catch a glimpse of his old home.
"This place used to be very busy, many people doing business around here and it was very easy to make money before the fighting started," Sam said, gazing toward the fortified line.
Sam said that to make ends meet he has had to pick up a few other jobs such as plumber, electrician, and some minor construction work for other villagers.
Rong Cham was built to house families who fled fighting between Cambodian and Thai troops that erupted in July 2025 over a long-contested stretch of their shared border of over 800 kilometres, and flared again in December before a ceasefire took hold. The clashes marked one of the most serious escalations between the two neighbours in years.
Cambodian authorities say the figure of those still unable to go home stands above 20,000, according to Tom Andrews, UN Special Rapporteur on human rights in Cambodia, who said Thai military positions now sit inside what Phnom Penh considers its own territory.
Thailand has denied that it is illegally occupying Cambodian territory, claiming that it is following a bilateral [USN:L1N3XX00H TEXT:"ceasefire agreement"]. Border crossings between the neighbours remain closed.
When asked for comment on the displaced villagers, Thailand's Ministry of Foreign Affairs referred to an August 1 statement in which it said it was up to the Cambodian government to handle care of any of its citizens affected by the fighting.
Sam said his household has been split by the crisis. His nine-year-old daughter has returned to live with him, while his adult son remains in Thailand with other family.
"It's about when I can get back to my old house and whether there would be a third (bout of) fighting," he said. "These are the two issues I worry about the most."

items.title: Moroccans vote in election set to shape government before World Cup
items.author: Ahmed Eljechtimi
items.creator: Ahmed Eljechtimi
items.summary: Moroccans vote in an election on Wednesday that will shape the government overseeing the final stages of a $20-billion push to prepare for the 2030 World Cup and projects to direct economic gains towards the country's disenchanted youth.
items.body:
Moroccans vote in an election on Wednesday that will shape the government overseeing the final stages of a $20-billion push to prepare for the 2030 World Cup and projects to direct economic gains towards the country's disenchanted youth.
The parliamentary poll is not expected to fundamentally alter the balance of power in Morocco, where the king retains sweeping powers over policy direction, defence and foreign affairs.
But the next parliament will be tasked with implementing initiatives increasingly aimed at addressing [USN:L6N4580D4 TEXT:"youth discontent"], highlighted by a mass border rush on the Spanish enclave of [USN:L8N43X1XA TEXT:"Ceuta"] and deadly [USN:L6N3VN095 TEXT:"Gen-Z-led protests"] last year.
The current government is made up of three parties – including two founded by men close to the palace – which unseated a moderate Islamist party that came to power a decade earlier after the 2011 Arab Spring protests.
Those demonstrations led the king to devolve more powers to an elected parliament before later reasserting control over areas such as foreign affairs and the interior ministry.
Under a constitution adopted in 2011, the king appoints the prime minister from the party that wins the highest share of parliament's 395 seats.
The prime minister must then negotiate a coalition before submitting a list of cabinet members for royal approval.
Polling stations will open at 8 a.m. (0800 GMT) and close at 7 p.m. (1900 GMT), and preliminary results are usually announced the day after an election.
The turnout, particularly among young voters, will be closely watched because it will be seen as a barometer for citizens' engagement and trust in elected institutions.
About 27 million Moroccans are of voting age, but only 15.8 million are registered on the electoral lists, a drop of about 12% from the 2021 election.
SPENDING PLANS The two biggest parties in the current parliament, the ruling National Rally of Independents (RNI) and the Authenticity and Modernity Party (PAM), have each pledged to create about 1 million jobs over the next five-year term, and made promises to improve housing, wages and hospitals.
The two govern together in a coalition but have traded blame during the campaign over a failure to halt the rise of food prices and other policy shortcomings.
Because of the disagreements, PAM leaders have ruled out joining another coalition with RNI if they come first.
Prime Minister Aziz Akhannouch, a billionaire businessman who has led the government since 2021, is not standing again after stepping down as RNI leader this year.
Fouzi Lekjaa, the budget minister and president of Morocco's football federation and chairman of the organising committee for the 2030 World Cup soccer finals, joined PAM's leadership weeks before the election.
Morocco is pouring investments into stadiums, railways and other infrastructure before the World Cup, which it will co-host with Spain and Portugal, and aims to double economic output per capita by 2035.
The International Monetary Fund has estimated the planned spending at around 190 billion dirhams, or around $20 billion, amounting to nearly 12% of its gross domestic product in 2024.
Other parties in contention include the ruling nationalist, conservative-leaning Istiqlal party (PI), the Islamist Justice and Development Party (PJD), which suffered a crushing defeat in the last vote, and a number of leftist parties.

items.title: Australian competition regulator blocks IAG's RAC Insurance takeover
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Australia's competition regulator on Wednesday blocked Insurance Australia Group's planned takeover of RAC Insurance, finding it would likely weaken competition in key insurance markets in Western Australia.
items.body:
Australia's competition regulator on Wednesday blocked Insurance Australia Group's (IAG.AX) planned takeover of RAC Insurance, finding it would likely weaken competition in key insurance markets in Western Australia.
The Australian Competition and Consumer Commission's (ACCC) decision follows a detailed phase two review into the proposed acquisition of the Royal Automobile Club of Western Australia's underwriting business and brand, first floated over a year ago.
Here are some more details:
The regulator said the acquisition could reduce competition in the supply of motor vehicle insurance and home and contents insurance in Western Australia.
“The acquisition would combine two large insurers, resulting in a substantial increase in IAG’s market share and a significant increase in market concentration,” ACCC Chair Gina Cass-Gottlieb said.
IAG agreed in May last year to acquire RAC Insurance's underwriting business in an A$1.35 billion ($959.85 million) deal expected to add about A$1.5 billion in gross written premium to IAG’s portfolio.
The ACCC added it found insufficient evidence that the deal would motivate IAG to restrict competitors' access to repair services.
It also concluded there was insufficient evidence to suggest the deal would substantially lessen competition in the smash repair services market in parts of Western Australia.
IAG acknowledged the ACCC's decision in a separate announcement and said it would seek public-benefits authorisation, allowing the deal's customer, community and economic benefits to be weighed alongside competition concerns.
"RAC will remain local, and we'll invest in enhancements to benefit the member experience, and continue to deliver high-quality, competitive insurance products and services," IAG CEO Nick Hawkins said.
RAC Insurance did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment.
IAG shares fell 2.2% in early trade, their lowest since September 10.
. ($1 = 1.4065 Australian dollars)

items.title: Las acciones asiáticas suben 0,4% y suman seis sesiones al alza tras récord del Nasdaq 100
items.author: Toby Alder
items.summary: El índice bursátil MSCI Asia Pacífico subió un 0,4%, con ganancias en los índices de Corea del Sur y Australia, mientras que los mercados japoneses permanecieron cerrados por festivo.
items.body: Bloomberg — Las bolsas asiáticas subieron por sexto día consecutivo después de que los fabricantes de chips impulsaran al Nasdaq 100 a su primer máximo histórico desde junio, mientras que la caída de los precios del petróleo proporcionó un impulso adicional a medida que avanzaban los esfuerzos diplomáticos para poner fin a la guerra con Irán. Ver más: Nasdaq marca otro récord, mientras el petróleo cae por señales de diálogo con Irán El índice bursátil MSCI Asia Pacífico subió un 0,4%, con ganancias en los índices de Corea del Sur y Australia, mientras que los mercados japoneses permanecieron cerrados por festivo. Estas ganancias regionales se produjeron después de que el índice Nasdaq 100 subiera un 0,8% , con un indicador de semiconductores muy observado que avanzó más del 2%. Shopify Inc. se disparó un 7,1% tras firmar una alianza con Meta Platforms Inc. ( META ) para su producto Muse AI. En otros mercados, el Brent extendió su caída el miércoles hasta los US$98,45 por barril, luego de que el presidente Donald Trump declarara que funcionarios estadounidenses habían mantenido una reunión “muy positiva” con enviados iraníes , mientras Washington renovaba sus esfuerzos para poner fin al conflicto. Los bonos del Tesoro se mantuvieron estables en toda la curva, el dólar subió ligeramente y el oro redujo sus pérdidas de la sesión anterior. Las perspectivas para la bolsa podrían depender de si la diplomacia logra hacer bajar el precio del petróleo, lo que aliviaría las preocupaciones sobre la inflación y reduciría la presión sobre los rendimientos de los bonos. Los inversores también están pendientes de la cumbre de esta semana entre Trump y el presidente chino, Xi Jinping, en busca de indicios de avance en las disputas comerciales y otras controversias económicas. “La atención seguirá centrada en la geopolítica, y si se confirma algún avance hacia un alto al fuego entre EE.UU. e Irán, cabe esperar que el petróleo y los rendimientos sigan bajando y que las acciones repunten”, afirmó Tom Essaye, de The Sevens Report. Ver más: Apuestas bajistas sobre el Brent alcanzan récord mientras el petróleo retrocede de los US$100 Los precios del petróleo fluctuaron después de que Irán propusiera reabrir el estrecho de Ormuz en un plazo de siete días y Arabia Saudí anunciara que espera reanudar las operaciones en su oleoducto Este-Oeste esta semana. Estas medidas se produjeron mientras la Administración Trump renovaba sus esfuerzos por poner fin al conflicto, y el presidente afirmaba que la guerra terminaría poco después de las elecciones de mitad de mandato de noviembre en EE.UU. El conflicto ha provocado un aumento de los precios de la gasolina, ha interrumpido los flujos mundiales de petróleo y ha llevado a Irán a atacar bases estadounidenses en la región, causando la muerte de 19 militares estadounidenses. Hasta ahora, Irán ha mantenido su control sobre el estrecho de Ormuz, mientras que los rebeldes hutíes de Yemen, respaldados por Irán, han vuelto a amenazar la navegación en el mar Rojo. “El aumento de los flujos a través del estrecho apunta a una pérdida de influencia por parte de Irán, lo que sugiere que podrían estar más dispuestos a llegar a un acuerdo que antes, pero también aumenta la probabilidad de una escalada en un intento por reafirmar su control”, afirmó Ryan McKay, estratega sénior de materias primas de TD Securities. Los inversores también están analizando minuciosamente los comentarios de la Fed en busca de pistas sobre la trayectoria de las tasas tras la subida de un cuarto de punto de la semana pasada. El presidente de la Fed de Richmond, Tom Barkin, advirtió de que las perturbaciones inflacionistas podrían tardar en remitir, mientras que Susan Collins, de la Fed de Boston, respaldó el alza y el presidente de la Fed de San Luis, Alberto Musalem, señaló que podrían ser necesarias nuevos aumentos. Ver más: Las acciones de pequeña capitalización pierden ventaja a medida que suben las tasas “El mercado ya está descontando tres incrementos de tasas a partir de ahora. Yo apostaría por la otra opción”, dijo Christian Hoffmann, director de renta fija de Thornburg Investment Management. “Cuatro subidas en el transcurso de un año representan una respuesta bastante drástica al contexto económico y tendrían repercusiones reales en la macroeconomía”. Esta noticia se ha elaborado con la ayuda de Bloomberg Automation. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: US judge dismisses Michigan climate lawsuit against oil companies
items.author: David Shepardson
items.creator: David Shepardson
items.summary: A US judge on Tuesday dismissed an antitrust lawsuit in which Michigan accused four major oil companies of colluding to forestall competition in renewable energy, including electric vehicles, a decision in line with prior rulings in similar cases.
items.body:
A US judge on Tuesday dismissed an antitrust lawsuit in which Michigan accused four major oil companies of colluding to forestall competition in renewable energy, including electric vehicles, a decision in line with prior rulings in similar cases.
US District Judge Jane Beckering in Grand Rapids rejected the lawsuit filed in January by Michigan Attorney General Dana Nessel, a Democrat, against BP (BP.L) , Chevron (CVX.N) , Exxon (XOM.N) , Shell (SHEL.L) and the American Petroleum Institute.
The judge said antitrust laws protect against none of the injuries for which Michigan sought a remedy, except for energy overcharges.
"The distance is too great between the alleged conspiracy and Michigan’s and its residents’ overcharges to find that the conspiracy proximately caused the overcharges," Beckering said.
The complaint said the companies sought to "restrain the emergence of electric vehicles and renewable primary energy technologies in the United States."
Other judges have rejected similar climate lawsuits including in Delaware, Maryland, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Puerto Rico and South Carolina.
A lawyer for Chevron previously called Michigan's lawsuit “baseless as demonstrated by multiple related court dismissals."
Chevron and the other companies have been fighting for years against lawsuits by state and local governments seeking to hold them responsible for climate change, many of which remain pending.
The Trump administration has taken a series of actions to make it easier for automakers to avoid building electric vehicles and make them more expensive for consumers to buy, reversing Biden administration policies.

SEOUL, Sept 23 : South Korea aims to reduce its reliance on crude oil from the Middle East to 50 per cent by 2035, as Asia's fourth-biggest economy seeks to diversify energy supplies following the disruption caused by the Iran war, the Industry Ministry said on Wednesday.
In its 10-year natural resources security plan, the ministry said the country needed a "fundamental shift" in its supply chains, citing lessons from the Iran war, which has choked off global energy flows.
South Korea relies heavily on oil imports and sourced 70 per cent of its supplies from the Middle East in 2025, most of it delivered through the Strait of Hormuz, according to the ministry.
Under the updated strategy, the country adjusted its stockpiling plan for crude oil, targeting an expansion of around 20 million barrels by 2030.

South Korea also aims to secure additional supplies of condensate, an ultra-light oil mainly used to produce naphtha, the ministry said. The country has struggled with a shortage of naphtha, the key feedstock for petrochemicals, since the Middle East conflict.
South Korea relies on imports to satisfy about 45 per cent of its naphtha demand, with 77 per cent of those supplies typically sourced from the Middle East, according to the ministry.
For natural gas, the government aims to cap its import dependence on the Middle East to below 30 per cent by 2035, after lowering it to 20 per cent in 2025.
The roadmap will also expand South Korea's list of critical minerals to 51 from 38, adding 10 rare earths and germanium, a critically important component for the production of semiconductors, as part of efforts to strengthen supply chains.

items.author: CNA

South Korea plans to cut its reliance on Middle crude oil imports to 50% by 2035

SEOUL, Sept 23 : South Korea aims to reduce its reliance on crude oil from the Middle East to 50 per cent by 2035, as Asia's fourth-biggest economy seeks to diversify energy supplies following the disruption caused by the Iran war, the Industry Ministry said on Wednesday.
In its 10-year natural resources security plan, the ministry said the country needed a "fundamental shift" in its supply chains, citing lessons from the Iran war, which has choked off global energy flows.
South Korea relies heavily on oil imports and sourced 70 per cent of its supplies from the Middle East in 2025, most of it delivered through the Strait of Hormuz, according to the ministry.
Under the updated strategy, the country adjusted its stockpiling plan for crude oil, targeting an expansion of around 20 million barrels by 2030.

South Korea also aims to secure additional supplies of condensate, an ultra-light oil mainly used to produce naphtha, the ministry said. The country has struggled with a shortage of naphtha, the key feedstock for petrochemicals, since the Middle East conflict.
South Korea relies on imports to satisfy about 45 per cent of its naphtha demand, with 77 per cent of those supplies typically sourced from the Middle East, according to the ministry.
For natural gas, the government aims to cap its import dependence on the Middle East to below 30 per cent by 2035, after lowering it to 20 per cent in 2025.
The roadmap will also expand South Korea's list of critical minerals to 51 from 38, adding 10 rare earths and germanium, a critically important component for the production of semiconductors, as part of efforts to strengthen supply chains.

Source: Reuters

items.title: China's US ambassador warns on 'red lines' ahead of Trump, Xi meeting
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: China's ambassador to the US warned on Wednesday that the country has "red lines" on Taiwan, human rights and other issues that cannot be crossed, ahead of this week's meeting in Washington between the two countries' leaders.
items.body:
China's ambassador to the US warned on Wednesday that the country has "red lines" on Taiwan, human rights and other issues that cannot be crossed, ahead of this week's meeting in Washington between the two countries' leaders.
Chinese President Xi Jinping will visit Washington for a summit with President Donald Trump, as both sides look to bring stability to ties overshadowed by arguments over everything from [USN:L8N45A068 TEXT:"trade"] to [USN:L1N45E095 TEXT:"Taiwan"].
Writing in the ruling Communist Party's official People's Daily, Ambassador Xie Feng said managing differences hinges on good faith, and the US should stop "fabricating pretexts" such as national security, economic imbalances and forced labour to try to and constrain China.
When China and the US cooperate, both benefit, but when they confront each other, both suffer, he added.
"China's sovereignty, security, and development interests cannot be violated, and four red lines — the Taiwan question, democracy and human rights, development paths and systems, and development rights — cannot be challenged," Xie said.
"China is committed to pursuing peaceful development and hopes the US will move toward this as well."
China claims democratically-governed Taiwan as its own territory, despite the objections of the government in Taipei. The US is Taiwan's most important arms supplier and international backer despite the lack of formal ties.
Xie said that top-level diplomacy is the "steady hand" of China-US relations and differences are not to be feared.
A separate commentary on Wednesday in the same newspaper said the US's "erroneous" perceptions of China and its inability to let go of the notion of strategic competition are the basic causes of their recent difficult relationship.
"In recent years, the tortuous path China-US relations have travelled clearly shows the US's erroneous perceptions of China and its unwillingness to let go of the notion of 'strategic competition' are the fundamental cause of recurring difficulties," said the commentary, without offering details.
Both sides should cherish the favourable momentum that has come at "great cost, maintain the right direction, and eliminate interference", said the article, published under the pen name "Zhong Sheng", meaning "Voice of China" and used to give views on foreign policy.
"The US side, in particular, needs to maintain continuity and stability in its policies, honour its commitments, and inject certainty into bilateral relations," it added.

items.title: ＮＢＡ＝ラプターズ、カワイ・レナードと契約延長─報道
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２２日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２２日　ロイター］ - 米プロバスケットボール協会（ＮＢＡ）のラプターズが、オールスター選出７回のカワイ・レナード（３５）と２年総額１億１５００万ドル（約１８１億円）の契約延長に合意した。米ＥＳＰＮが２２日に報じた。

代理人の話によると、２０２８─２９シーズンは選手オプション。レナードは今月１４日にクリッパーズからの移籍を完了させていた。レナードは最大契約延長額より１１００万ドル少ない金額を受け入れ、トレードキッカー（トレード時にボーナスが保証される契約条項）７５０万ドルも放棄した。

当初、レナードのラプターズ復帰は６月３０日に合意されていたが、レナードとクリッパーズによるサラリーキャップ（年俸総額制限）規定回避を巡るＮＢＡの調査を受けて、長く保留となっていた。

ＮＢＡは今月２日、クリッパーズがレナードを巡ってサラリーキャップ規定を回避したとして、球団に３０００万ドルの罰金を科し、２９年から３３年までのドラフト１巡目指名権を剥奪。レナードにも７０万ドルの支払いを命じた。

items.title: Belgian Van Kerckhove out of UCI Road World Championships after training crash
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Belgian cyclist Seff Van Kerckhove did not participate in the men's junior individual time trial at the UCI Road World Championships in Montreal on Tuesday as he recovers after being hit by a motorist during a training ride earlier this week.
items.body:
Belgian cyclist Seff Van Kerckhove did not participate in the men's junior individual time trial at the UCI Road World Championships in Montreal on Tuesday as he recovers after being hit by a motorist during a training ride earlier this week.
Van Kerckhove, a podium hopeful who was also supposed to compete in the road race on Thursday, was taken to hospital for further examinations after a collision that the Belgian cycling federation said had a "severe impact" on his upper body.
"Seff will now take time for his recovery. The rehab has already started," the Belgian cycling federation said. "We wish him a speedy recovery."
Van Kerckhove was not replaced in the individual time trial and will not be replaced in the road race.

items.title: ロシアが新たな大規模攻撃を計画、ゼレンスキー氏警告
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２２日 ロイター] - ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は２２日、ロシアが新たな大規模攻撃を計画しているとの見方を示した。

国連総会に合わせて行ったバーナム英首相との会談について通信アプリ「テレグラム」に投稿し、新たな防空システムの確保に向けて同盟国と絶えず連携していると明らかにした。

その上で「ロシアがウクライナに対する新たな大規模攻撃を準備しているとの情報が現在入っている」とした。

「ウクライナ国民が日々、ミサイルやドローン（無人機）による攻撃の脅威にさらされる」中で、対ロシア制裁の緩和を議論する余地はあり得ないとも強調した。

items.title: Cambodia hosts anti-scam summit, seeking to showcase crackdown
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Cambodia will open a global conference on countering cyberfraud on Wednesday, as the government seeks to show it is serious about cracking down on the multibillion-dollar scam industry.
items.body:
Cambodia will open a global conference on countering cyberfraud on Wednesday, as the government seeks to show it is serious about cracking down on the multibillion-dollar scam industry.
Representatives from more than a dozen countries, including the United States and China, will attend the two-day gathering in Phnom Penh. Cambodian authorities say they have eradicated industrial-scale scam compounds, a claim met with skepticism by some analysts.
Cambodia and other Southeast Asian nations have become hubs for the transnational cyberscam industry, with mostly Chinese-led criminal gangs operating compounds where trafficking victims are detained and coerced into carrying out romance scams, police-impersonation fraud and other schemes.
On Monday and Tuesday, reporters toured sprawling centres shuttered by the government – one housing as many as 20,000 workers. They also viewed materials seized by police, including fake FBI and Chinese police badges used in impersonation schemes.
Under pressure from countries including the US, which estimates that Americans lost more than $10 billion to scammers operating in the region in 2024 alone, Cambodia says it has raided hundreds of compounds and deported hundreds of thousands of people over the past year.
But analysts and opposition figures say the raids have left politically connected figures who allegedly protected the networks untouched, while criminal groups have adapted by breaking into smaller units and moving operations overseas.
The credibility of the crackdown “will depend on whether the Cambodian state is willing to investigate all credible allegations, regardless of wealth, influence or official position," Mu Sochua, an exiled opposition politician, said in a statement.
items.raw_description: Cambodia will open a global conference on countering cyberfraud on Wednesday, as the government seeks to show it is serious about cracking down on the multibillion-dollar scam industry.

items.title: トランプ氏、ディーゼル燃料禁輸を支持　記録的高水準の価格抑制へ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Gram Slattery　Ryan Patrick Jones　Timothy Gardner

[国連 ２２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Gram Slattery　Ryan Patrick Jones　Timothy Gardner

[国連 ２２日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２２日、ディーゼル燃料の輸出禁止を支持すると表明した。１１月の中間選挙で接戦となっている一部の選挙区の共和党候補らが、記録的水準に達している燃料価格を抑制する手段としてこの措置を求めていた。

トランプ氏はウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領との会談を前に記者団に対し、「私はディーゼル燃料の輸出はやめようと言ってきた。側近たちに対してそう訴えてきた」と述べた。

同席したベセント財務長官は、こうした禁止措置が実現可能かどうか、また全面禁輸と部分禁輸のどちらが効果的かを政権が検討していると述べた。

トランプ氏がディーゼル燃料の輸出禁止を支持したことで、同氏はエネルギー当局者らと対立する形となった。

当局者らは、この措置が沿岸部の燃料価格を押し上げ、欧州の同盟国向けの供給を逼迫させる可能性があると警告している。

ライト・エネルギー長官は先週、保守系メディア「デイリー・コーラー」のイベントで、禁止措置は米メキシコ湾岸でディーゼル燃料の供給過剰を招き、米製油業者に稼働率の引き下げを促し、ガソリン生産の急速な減少につながると指摘。「流通に障壁を設け始めれば、極めて速やかに生産が減少し、供給が細る。われわれに必要なのは供給の増加であって、減少ではない」と語った。

また、バーガム内務長官は、禁止措置が石油製品価格を押し下げる可能性は低く、エネルギー輸出国による報復措置を招きかねないと述べた。カリフォルニア州などはエネルギーの一部をこうした輸出国に依存している。

items.title: ECB、経済成長抑制する水準まで利上げ必要にも－ナーゲル独連銀総裁
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 欧州中央銀行（ECB）政策委員会メンバーのナーゲル・ドイツ連邦銀行（中銀）総裁は22日夜、経済成長を抑制する水準まで金利を引き上げる必要が生じる可能性があるとの考えを示した。

ナーゲル氏は訪問先のロンドンで、「このようなエネルギー価格の高止まりが長期化する状況に直面した場合、金融政策を緩やかな景気抑制領域に移行しなければならない可能性を排除できない」と述べた上で、そうなるかどうかを判断するのは時期尚早だと指摘した。

ECBは2回の利上げを経て引き締めを継続すると広く予想されており、市場は今回の利上げ局面であと最大3回の利上げを織り込んでいる。ユーロ圏のインフレ率は3%を上回り、ECBが目標とする2%をさらに1年間上回ると予想されている。

ナーゲル氏は、ドイツなどで今後予定される賃金交渉に言及し、「私が、あるいはわれわれが懸念しているのは、これが二次的影響につながる可能性があることだ」と語った。

「これが長期化すれば二次的影響が出てくることは、誰もが分かっている」とし、そのため「われわれは警戒を怠ってはならない」と強調。「このような状況でわれわれが言っているのは、まさにそのことだ。そして約束できるが、われわれは警戒している」と説明した。

items.title: 'Totally outrageous': Tom Cruise unleashes 'Digger' at star‑studded royal premiere
items.author: Francesca Halliwell
items.creator: Francesca Halliwell
items.summary: Tom Cruise described his character in "Digger" as "totally outrageous" and unlike any role he had encountered before, speaking at the film's world premiere in London on Tuesday.
items.body:
Tom Cruise described his character in "Digger" as "totally outrageous" and unlike any role he had encountered before, speaking at the film's world premiere in London on Tuesday.
"He's the kind of character that says things that some people think, some people can't imagine thinking," the Hollywood star told Reuters. "I've never read a character like it. I've never read a film like this."
The release of "Digger" was celebrated with a royal premiere attended by Britain's Prince William and Princess Kate, after what actor Sandra Huller described as nearly 10 years of work by Oscar-winning director Alejandro G. Inarritu.
The film has generated much anticipation since a trailer showed Cruise transformed into eccentric oil tycoon Digger Rockwell with grey hair, facial prosthetics and a padded bodysuit.
Cruise said this transformation was far from the most demanding aspect of the role, pointing instead to a 10-minute monologue filmed in a single take.
"Anatomy of a Fall" star Huller said it was "remarkable" watching Cruise's performance. "It feels like all the things that he has learned in 46 years of acting have come into this character," she added.
In the film, Rockwell inadvertently triggers an ecological disaster that pushes the world to the brink of nuclear war before scrambling to save the planet. But the filmmakers have revealed little else about the story, fuelling speculation about the plot and rumours it could be a musical, which Cruise has dismissed.
"If you experience the film without knowing anything about it, it's much better than if you (knew) before," Huller said, adding that the secrecy was not intended to create intrigue for its own sake.
While Cruise described the story as an exploration of "power and greed...responsibility and irresponsibility", Australian actor Sophie Wilde said it also carried a message about art being "a vessel for catharsis."
Inarritu, whose previous credits include "Birdman" and "The Revenant", compared the process of making "Digger" to painting, saying every frame was carefully crafted to immerse audiences in the world of the film.
For Emma D'Arcy, that attention to detail made working with the Mexican filmmaker feel like being part of an orchestra led by a conductor. "With 'Digger', musicality was really, really important...it's a comedy, and so rhythm is kind of key."
"Call Me by Your Name" star Michael Stuhlbarg recalled scenes constantly evolving during filming, with new dialogue, alternative versions and unexpected additions emerging from one day to the next.
The actor joked that so much unusual material was shot that he hopes one day a DVD with additional footage from the production may be released.
"There was a lot of fun to be had," he said.
"Digger" will begin its global cinematic rollout on September 30, and will be released in cinemas in the United States and the United Kingdom on October 2.
items.raw_description: Tom Cruise described his character in "Digger" as "totally outrageous" and unlike any role he had encountered before, speaking at the film's world premiere in London on Tuesday.

items.title: Mexico arrests alleged prominent fentanyl trafficker
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: An alleged Mexican drug trafficker accused of coordinating and financing an organization dedicated to transporting chemical precursors used for the production of fentanyl from China to Mexico and the United States was arrested in Mexico City on Tuesday, Mexico's security minister said.
items.body:
An alleged Mexican drug trafficker accused of coordinating and financing an organization dedicated to transporting chemical precursors used for the production of fentanyl from China to Mexico and the United States was arrested in Mexico City on Tuesday, Mexico's security minister said.
Jose Angel Rivera, also known by his alias Don Flaco, was detained by Mexican authorities in a joint operation carried out alongside the FBI and the US Drug Enforcement Administration, Omar Garcia Harfuch said in a post on X.
Rivera had been sanctioned by the US State Department in January 2023 for his alleged involvement in fentanyl trafficking into the US.
"Through international cooperation, shared responsibility, and unrestricted respect for our sovereignty, we are cutting off the flow of money that finances the criminal organizations causing so much harm in Mexico and other countries," Harfuch said.
Earlier on Tuesday, US President Donald Trump told the United Nations that Mexico was the [USN:L1N45E0KV TEXT:"epicenter of drug cartel violence"], adding that the country had to reclaim control of its territory.

items.title: サッカー＝ボルシアＭＧ、ブレッシン氏が新監督に　板倉ら所属
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２２日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２２日　ロイター］ - サッカーのドイツ１部ブンデスリーガで、板倉滉らが所属するボルシアＭＧは２２日、アレクサンダー・ブレッシン氏を新監督に任命した。契約は２０２８年６月まで。

ボルシアＭＧは今季開幕からリーグ戦４連敗を喫し、最下位に低迷。１３日にオイゲン・ポランスキ前監督を解任し、ヤンモリッツ・リヒテ氏を暫定監督に据えたが、１９日のマインツ戦にも３─４で敗れた。

ブレッシン氏は２４年から２年間、ザンクトパウリを指揮。就任１年目は残留に導いたが、昨季は２部に降格した。ドイツでトップチームを率いたのはザンクトパウリが初めてだったが、以前にはラルフ・ラングニック氏の下でライプチヒの育成年代を８年間指導。オーステンデ、サンジロワーズ（ともにベルギー）、ジェノア（イタリア）でも監督を務めた。

ボルシアＭＧには板倉のほか、橋岡大樹、宇野禅斗、町野修斗が所属している。

items.title: Wife of US seismologist held in China says Trump will ask Xi to free him
items.author: Jonathan Landay
items.creator: Jonathan Landay
items.summary: The wife of a US expert on North Korean nuclear tests who has been imprisoned in China since late 2024 said on Tuesday the White House has assured her that President Donald Trump will ask Chinese leader Xi Jinping to free her husband when the pair meet this week.
items.body:
The wife of a US expert on North Korean nuclear tests who has been imprisoned in China since late 2024 said on Tuesday the White House has assured her that President Donald Trump will ask Chinese leader Xi Jinping to free her husband when the pair meet this week.
Yufang Rong said she feared that Beijing planned to try her Chinese-born husband, Youlin Chen, on fabricated espionage charges even though his US-funded research was openly published, used publicly available data and was done in collaboration with Chinese scientists.
Trump will welcome Xi on Wednesday for their second meeting since May as the leaders of the world's leading powers seek stability amid tensions ranging from [USN:L8N45A068 TEXT:"trade "]to [USN:L8N4550G3 TEXT:"Iran "]and [USN:L4N45D00S TEXT:"Taiwan"].
Rong said she was assured during a Tuesday meeting at the White House with officials from the State Department and National Security Council that Trump would ask Xi to free her husband.
Chen, 54, is one of two Americans held by Beijing that the US has designated as "wrongfully detained," making their release a top priority. The [USN:L1N44G127 TEXT:"other"] is Min Zin, a scholar arrested in June.
Rong said she was told that Trump also would press Xi to release Zin.
Trump raised Chen's case with Xi during a visit to Beijing in May, but it produced no action, Rong said.
"Resolving the wrongful detentions of US citizens is always a top priority for the president," a senior US official said, speaking on the condition of anonymity to discuss sensitive matters.
The Chinese embassy did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The Chinese foreign ministry said in July that the country's judiciary deals with cases according to the law "and there is no so-called wrongful detention."
'BE STRONG' Chen, whose detention was [USN:L6N43F03L TEXT:"revealed"] by Reuters in July, is a seismologist with a US government contractor. His work detecting shockwaves from North Korean underground nuclear tests has been openly funded by the State Department and the US Air Force Research Laboratory.
He became a US citizen in 2011 and settled in the Boston area.
He was arrested by Chinese state security officers on November 5, 2024, at Beijing International Airport as he prepared to fly home after visiting family and lecturing at two universities. Rong said her husband had been interrogated more than 100 times.
"I can't imagine how hard his life is there every day," she said.
She believes that China wants to use her husband's expertise to improve its ability to conceal nuclear tests using decoupling, a technique in which a device is detonated inside a large underground chamber to reduce the size of the shockwaves.
The US has [USN:L1N3ZD0Z2 TEXT:"accused"] China of using decoupling to try to mask a low-yield nuclear test blast on June 22, 2020. China, which like the US has signed but not ratified a 1996 international ban on nuclear tests, denies conducting the test.
US embassy officials had been allowed to visit Chen for about 30 minutes once a month, always in the presence of Chinese officials, Rong said. They read out letters she had written to him and he dictated his replies.
"They record his appearance, his mental status, and just anything that they observe," she recounted, adding that Chen's Chinese lawyer was not allowed to discuss his visits with her.
Rong is concerned about the conditions of her husband's confinement, where she said he received substandard medical care and food. He suffered from high blood pressure and diabetes.
Asked what she would say to her husband if she could see him, Rong replied: "'Be strong. Be optimistic. There are a lot of people helping you. You will come back for sure.'"

items.title: Iglesia católica de Panamá presenta informe con 37 casos de abuso sexual
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La Iglesia Católica de Panamá divulgó el martes un informe que incluye 24 casos de abuso sexual que vinculan a miembros de la arquidiócesis capitalina, con hechos registrados entre 2001 y 2025, informó una comisión independiente que documentó los incidentes.
items.body:
La Iglesia Católica de Panamá divulgó el martes un informe que incluye 24 casos de abuso sexual que vinculan a miembros de la arquidiócesis capitalina, con hechos registrados entre 2001 y 2025, informó una comisión independiente que documentó los incidentes.
El documento, elaborado en colaboración con la Universidad de Notre Dame (Estados Unidos) y la Universidad Villanueva (España), detalla que entre las víctimas, 37 en total, se encuentran nueve menores de edad y 11 adultos en situación de vulnerabilidad.
"Nos duele saber que quienes debieron encontrar en la Iglesia un espacio de acogida, de cuidado, de confianza, hayan experimentado situaciones que les han causado heridas tan profundas", dijo durante la presentación del expediente el arzobispo panameño, José Domingo Ulloa.
Por su parte, el sacerdote Jordi Pujol, coordinador de la Comisión de Transparencia encargada de elaborar el informe, dijo que 24 de las denuncias involucran responsabilidades dentro de la Arquidiócesis de Panamá.
Pujol agregó que el documento también detalla las dificultades que enfrentaron víctimas o testigos para presentar las denuncias, así como las debilidades identificadas en materia de reparación.

items.title: ＭＬＢ＝メッツ、グリーン監督と3年契約　千賀所属
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２２日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２２日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）で千賀滉大投手が所属するメッツは２２日、暫定監督を務めていたアンディ・グリーン氏（４９）と３年契約を結び、正式監督に昇格させた。

グリーン氏は６月２６日にカルロス・メンドサ前監督が解任された後、暫定監督に就任。レギュラーシーズン残り６試合の時点で、指揮を執った７５試合で３７勝３８敗としている。

メッツは今季、約３億５６００万ドル（約５６０億円）の総年俸を抱えながらナ・リーグ東地区最下位に低迷。４月には１２連敗を喫し、メンドサ前監督が解任された時点でも６連敗中で、成績は３４勝４７敗だった。

グリーン氏はニュースリリースを通じ、「暫定監督を引き受けた時は正式就任することになるとは思っていなかった。選手やスタッフと過ごす時間が増えるにつれ、自分の情熱と経験を最も生かせる場所だと明確になった」と述べた。

グリーン氏は２０１６─１９年にパドレスの監督を務め、２７４勝３６６敗の成績を残した。２０─２３年にはカブスでベンチコーチを務めた。

items.title: Ｆ１＝角田が再びリザーブへ、レッドブルでハジャー復帰に伴い
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［バクー　２２日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［バクー　２２日　ロイター］ - 自動車レースＦ１のレーシングブルズで直近３戦に出場していた角田裕毅が、今週末のアゼルバイジャン・グランプリ（ＧＰ）から再びリザーブの役割に戻る見通しとなった。レッドブルが２２日、手首のけがで欠場していたアイザック・ハジャー（フランス）の復帰を発表した。

ハジャーはマックス・フェルスタッペン（オランダ）とともにレッドブルから出場する。ハジャーの代役を務めていたリアム・ローソン（ニュージーランド）がレーシングブルズに戻るため、ローソンに代わって英国人ルーキーのアービッド・リンドブラッドと組んでいた角田はシートを譲る形となる。

ハジャーはオランダ、イタリア、スペインの各ＧＰを欠場。ローソンはその３戦のうち２戦で入賞した。

アゼルバイジャンＧＰは２４日にフリー走行が始まり、同国の戦没者を悼む「追悼の日」のため、決勝は通常の日曜日（２７日）ではなく土曜日（２６日）に行われる。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２２日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２２日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）ドジャースが、佐々木朗希投手（２４）とアンディ・パヘス外野手（２５）を負傷者リスト（ＩＬ）から復帰させた。

佐々木は８月２６日のブレーブス戦で右手中指にまめができて以降、登板していなかった。今季は２３試合全てに先発し、５勝５敗、防御率４．６０。デーブ・ロバーツ監督は、プレーオフで佐々木を救援で起用する見通しを示している。

パヘスは８月２１日のパイレーツ戦で相手投手の投球を左手に受けて以来、戦列を離れていた。今季は１２８試合に出場し、打率２割７分２厘、２１本塁打、８０打点を記録。今季初めてオールスターに選出された。

また複数の報道によると、ドジャースは同日、ライアン・ウォード外野手（２８）の契約をプロ野球・中日に譲渡した。マイナー生活が長かったウォードは今季メジャーデビューを果たし、２０試合で３本塁打。昨季はパシフィック・コースト・リーグ（ＰＣＬ）の最優秀選手（ＭＶＰ）に選ばれていたが、先週に事実上の戦力外となる措置を受けていた。

items.title: Seahawks coach: Broncos' Payton accused team of cheating in 2024
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Denver Broncos coach Sean Payton accused the Seattle Seahawks of cheating during the 2024 season and Seattle threatened a lawsuit in response, Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said.
items.body:
Denver Broncos coach Sean Payton accused the Seattle Seahawks of cheating during the 2024 season and Seattle threatened a lawsuit in response, Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said.
The Broncos lost 26-20 to the host Seahawks in the season opener on Sept. 8, 2024, which was Macdonald's debut as head coach.
Macdonald gave his account of what happened during a recent appearance on the "In Depth with Graham Bensinger" podcast, with a clip surfacing on Tuesday.
In preparation for the 2024 game, Seahawks coaches scouted about 100 plays from Broncos training camp that had been shared by fans on social media.
"It's like public knowledge," Macdonald said.
At some point during the season, Payton learned of the scouting, contacted Seattle general manager John Schneider and accused the Seahawks of rules violations, Macdonald said. The Broncos coach referenced the New England Patriots' Spygate scandal and the University of Michigan's sign-stealing scandal, Macdonald said.
"He got wind of it, and he lost it," said Macdonald, who was defensive coordinator at Michigan for one season in 2021. "He called John (Schneider). He basically threatened to come out publicly and do a whole Patriot, like Spygate type of thing. And I'm sitting there thinking, ‘Oh my God, we didn't cheat.' He thought it was a Michigan thing, or we had a plant and the whole thing.
"So, we had to counter with him to say, ‘Hey, look, if you come out with this, we're going to sue you, because it's not true.' ... He backed down, but he was killing John, our GM."
Macdonald denied the allegation when Schneider asked him, telling him, "That's not how we do business."
The Seattle coach said on the podcast that Payton had "let it go" by the end of the season.
"But it was like the Cold War," Macdonald said. "He's like, ‘I'm going to hit the button. I'm going to hit the button.' ‘Well, we're going to hit the button.' None of us hit the button."
Macdonald said Payton was courteous when they were at the NFL Scouting Combine the following spring in Indianapolis.
The teams play in Denver on Oct. 15 in a Thursday night game.
The Seahawks do not allow fans to record video at training camp practices. The Broncos have not allowed fans to record practice the past two summers, The Athletic reported.
Macdonald, 39, now in his third season, led the Seahawks to the Super Bowl title last season, 29-13 over the Patriots.
Payton, 62, is in his fourth season as head coach of the Broncos after guiding the New Orleans Saints from 2006-21, including the Super Bowl championship in the 2009 season.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Reports: Wild sign reigning GM of the Year Bill Guerin to contract extension
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Minnesota Wild have signed general manager Bill Guerin to a multi-year contract extension, according to multiple media reports, one week after locking in head coach John Hynes on a multi-year extension.
items.body:
The Minnesota Wild have signed general manager Bill Guerin to a multi-year contract extension, according to multiple media reports, one week after locking in head coach John Hynes on a multi-year extension.
Guerin, who served as GM of the gold medal-winning U.S. men's hockey team at the 2026 Olympics, is entering his eighth season as Wild GM. The former NHL forward and Pittsburgh Penguins executive, now 55, also has held the title of president of hockey operations in Minnesota since 2023.
ESPN first reported the news on Guerin.
Minnesota has made the NHL playoffs in 12 of the past 14 seasons but not once advanced past the second round. Guerin, named NHL General Manager of the Year in June after a 104-point season, has recently tried to reverse that trend by executing a series of bold transactions. The team signed star winger Kirill Kaprizov to a record-breaking, eight-year, $136 million contract extension last fall that was the most lucrative in league history. The Wild acquired star defenseman Quinn Hughes in a blockbuster trade with the Vancouver Canucks in December.
Guerin and Hughes' representatives have recently discussed a possible extension for the 26-year-old blue-liner, according to reports. Hughes, who won the Norris Memorial Trophy in the 2023-24 season as the league's top defenseman, is scheduled to become an unrestricted free agent next summer.
Minnesota opens the 2026-27 regular season on the road against the Nashville Predators on Oct. 1.
--Field Level Media

items.title: UK ready to lead global push on AI Standards, Burnham tells UN
items.author: Elizabeth Piper
items.creator: Elizabeth Piper
items.summary: Prime Minister Andy Burnham told the United Nations that Britain was ready to lead an international effort to establish AI standards, citing concerns that the technology could outpace safeguards and pose mounting national security risks.
items.body:
Prime Minister Andy Burnham told the United Nations that Britain was ready to lead an international effort to establish AI standards, citing concerns that the technology could outpace safeguards and pose mounting national security risks.
"We've all [USN:L8N45D0T9 TEXT:"heard the warnings"] – which we must heed," he said in his inaugural speech to the United Nations General Assembly. "I know how worried people are. So we have to rise to this moment."
At his first multinational meeting in New York as Britain's seventh prime minister in a decade, Burnham made his support for AI the focus of his bid for Britain to assume a role on the global stage, rebuilding its diplomatic status.
He has said that rather than become a "[USN:L1N45D0WF TEXT:"doom-monger"]" about AI, he wanted Britain to pursue the huge benefits it could bring while being clear about the risks, which range from safeguards failing to keep up and hostile actors using it to wage an information war.
"Russian agencies have used every means at their disposal to spread lies and disinformation and prey on people's fears," he said.
"They've used bots and fake websites. Falsified newspaper articles. Forged the branding of 28 British organisations – including universities and the BBC. They've amplified far right narratives. And we have evidence that they tried to interfere with the 2019 General Election."
Russia has rejected the allegations.
Burnham said he would position Britain as an "honest broker" to take a leadership role, citing its close US ties, improving EU relationship and decent relations with China and India.
Britain has a [USN:L8N45D0PM TEXT:"world-leading AI Security Institute"], which works hand in glove with the US and the leading labs on AI safety, he said, but it needed to go further.
In [USN:L1N4590CK TEXT:"discussions with AI leaders"], officials have made clear Britain expects full and total visibility of new frontier models to strengthen the UK's preparedness and resilience, his office said.
Burnham said fundamental decisions on AI had to be taken by elected governments, not left to tech companies, and he would put AI at the heart of Britain's presidency of the G20 next year.
"We will work towards agreeing a single set of global principles and standards to ensure the transparency and access we need to increase our preparedness – and to ensure that AI development is safe," he said.
Burnham announced a new National Centre for Information Defence to detect, attribute and disrupt hostile state information attacks and identify deepfakes damaging British interests.
"Today I am tasking our security chiefs to begin work on a new National Centre for Information Defence – to detect, attribute and disrupt these kinds of hostile state information attacks – to support and defend our democracy," he said.

items.title: Zelenskiy diz que Rússia planeja novo ataque em grande escala contra Ucrânia
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O presidente ucraniano, Volodymyr Zelenskiy, afirmou que a Rússia está planejando um novo ataque em grande escala contra seu país, em declarações publicadas nesta terça-feira.
items.body:
O presidente ucraniano, Volodymyr Zelenskiy, afirmou que a Rússia está planejando um novo ataque em grande escala contra seu país, em declarações publicadas nesta terça-feira.
Zelenskiy, em uma postagem no Telegram sobre seu encontro com o primeiro-ministro britânico, Andy Burnham, à margem da Assembleia Geral da ONU, disse que a Ucrânia mantém comunicação constante com seus aliados para garantir novos sistemas de defesa antiaérea.
“Há informações de inteligência neste momento de que a Rússia está preparando um novo ataque em grande escala contra a Ucrânia”, escreveu Zelenskiy.
Ele afirmou que não poderia haver qualquer discussão sobre a flexibilização das sanções contra a Rússia “enquanto os ucranianos vivem todos os dias sob a ameaça de ataques com mísseis e drones”.
As forças russas há muito tempo realizam ataques noturnos em grande escala com drones e mísseis, mas alteraram suas táticas nas últimas semanas, lançando rajadas constantes ao longo do dia.
Moscou também, nos últimos meses, implantou drones a jato, que voam em altitudes mais elevadas e contornam as defesas aéreas, prejudicando as atividades comerciais, o governo e a vida cotidiana em uma escala muito maior do que anteriormente nesta guerra que já dura quatro anos e meio.

items.title: Senador republicano pede investigação sobre negócios da família Trump
items.author: Susan Heavey
items.creator: Susan Heavey
items.summary: Um senador republicano dos Estados Unidos pediu nesta terça-feira que se investigue se a família do presidente Donald Trump está lucrando com seu mandato, afirmando que qualquer percepção de que parentes estejam se aproveitando de sua posição mina a confiança no governo.
items.body:
Um senador republicano dos Estados Unidos pediu nesta terça-feira que se investigue se a família do presidente Donald Trump está lucrando com seu mandato, afirmando que qualquer percepção de que parentes estejam se aproveitando de sua posição mina a confiança no governo.
O senador John Curtis escreveu uma carta ao Comitê Judiciário do Senado solicitando uma investigação sobre as empresas de propriedade do filho mais velho de Trump, Donald Trump Jr., e sobre os pagamentos feitos por um oligarca russo para as comemorações de seu casamento nas Bahamas neste ano. Os democratas do Congresso iniciaram uma investigação na semana passada sobre os pagamentos relacionados ao casamento.
O presidente do comitê, Chuck Grassley, disse a jornalistas que vai avaliar o pedido com seriedade, mas alertou que a decisão sobre a investigação deve levar tempo. Não shá expectativa de uma decisão antes das eleições de meio de mandato, em 3 de novembro.
A carta aberta é o mais recente exemplo de republicanos proeminentes que tentam criar alguma distância entre si e o presidente cada vez mais impopular a seis semanas das eleições de meio de mandato, nas quais seu partido defende majorias estreitas no Congresso dos EUA.
Os candidatos republicanos ao Senado Ashley Hinson e Mike Rogers pediram o fim imediato da guerra no Irã, um conflito impopular que elevou os preços da energia e o custo de vida -- principal preocupação dos norte-americanos à medida que se aproximam as eleições.
O republicano Paul LePage, ex-governador do Maine que concorre a uma vaga na Câmara, criticou a deportação de imigrantes sem documentos promovida por Trump e argumentou que a repressão deveria se concentrar em membros de gangues e criminosos violentos.
“Não acho que seja o começo do fim”, disse o senador republicano Thom Tillis, da Carolina do Norte, a jornalistas quando questionado sobre o significado dos comentários dos candidatos. “Mas eles precisam ter flexibilidade para expressar quaisquer preocupações reais que tenham, porque os eleitores também têm essas preocupações.”
Ao contrário de Rogers, Hinson e LePage, Curtis, de Utah, autor da carta, só concorrerá às eleições em 2030. Tillis deve se aposentar em janeiro.
Uma pesquisa da Reuters/Ipsos divulgada nesta semana mostrou que a aprovação pública de Trump está em 32%, seu nível mais baixo de todos os tempos, e que o apoio à eleição de republicanos nas eleições de meio de mandato também está enfraquecendo.
Questionado sobre os republicanos em estados-chave que pedem o fim da guerra contra o Irã, o vice-presidente dos EUA, JD Vance, disse a jornalistas que era “completamente razoável que os republicanos adaptassem suas mensagens de campanha”.
"QUESTÕES LEGÍTIMAS" Na carta, Curtis instou o comitê do Senado a investigar as relações familiares do presidente e a possível influência exercida sobre elas por entidades nacionais e estrangeiras, incluindo festas de casamento no valor de centenas de milhares de dólares para Trump Jr., pagas pelo oligarca russo Umar Kremlev.
Curtis também levantou questões sobre os empreendimentos comerciais de Trump Jr., incluindo promoção de criptomoedas, negócios imobiliários, plataformas de mercado de previsões e outros, enquanto seu pai controla a Casa Branca.
“Essas reportagens levantam questões legítimas sobre o acesso de estrangeiros a membros da família de um presidente em exercício e se tais relações podem criar expectativas, reais ou percebidas, de tratamento favorável”, escreveu ele. “Elas também podem criar expectativas de um favor em troca que... poderia até mesmo gerar vulnerabilidades à segurança nacional.”
Trump disse na semana passada que seu filho está reembolsando Kremlev, mas não forneceu outros detalhes.
A família Trump tem defendido seus negócios enquanto Trump está no cargo e negado qualquer conflito de interesses, apontando para um fundo fiduciário administrado por Trump Jr. e Eric Trump.
Representantes de Trump Jr. não responderam a um pedido de comentário.
Um porta-voz disse que o comitê do Senado recebeu a carta, mas há um prazo “extremamente limitado” para agendar audiências neste ano.
