items.title: Major hurricane Polo intensifies off Mexico's Pacific coast
items.author: Aida Pelaez-fernandez, Raul Cortes
items.creator: Aida Pelaez-fernandez, Raul Cortes
items.summary: Hurricane Polo, which earlier on Tuesday reached Category 5 strength, the highest possible, continued intensifying off Mexico's Pacific coast, posing life-threatening flooding risks, the US National Hurricane Center said.
items.body:
Hurricane Polo, which earlier on Tuesday reached Category 5 strength, the highest possible, continued intensifying off Mexico's Pacific coast, posing life-threatening flooding risks, the US National Hurricane Center said.
Despite its proximity and the heavy rains it will bring, Polo is expected to move slowly off the coast in the next couple of days and shift its trajectory heading farther from the shore, an NHC advisory added.
"A turn toward the northwest and west-northwest is expected tonight and Wednesday," NHC warned. "On the forecast track, the core of Polo is expected to be near the coast of southwestern Mexico during the next few days, although forecast to remain offshore."
With maximum sustained winds near 165 mph (270 km/h), some additional strengthening is likely through Tuesday night. A National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) Hurricane Hunter aircraft is en route to investigate Polo, the advisory added.
Polo, classified by the NHC as "extremely dangerous", is currently located some 205 miles (335 km) south of the tourist town of Zihuatanejo and 345 miles south-southeast of the port city of Manzanillo.
Rainfall in the coastal states of Guerrero and Michoacan is expected to produce life-threatening flooding and mudslides, while less harmful rains are also expected in coastal portions of Oaxaca, Colima and Jalisco states, NHC said.
Mexican authorities warned of intense rainfall forecast for western and southern parts of the country, which could cause rivers to overflow.
Private forecaster AccuWeather noted that the storm’s reach could extend to tourist destinations such as Acapulco and Puerto Vallarta, while southern Baja California Sur, including the Los Cabos area, could also face storm surges and strong wind gusts by Sunday.
Afterwards, the storm could track farther inland and towards the US but will be influenced by an interaction with Tropical Storm Odalys, which could keep the hurricane farther offshore and limit tropical moisture from reaching the southwestern US.
Polo’s strong winds and rains are also expected to reach Lazaro Cardenas and Manzanillo, the country’s main ports.
“So far, the information we have is that (Polo) will not make a direct landfall on the coast; it will skirt around (...) particularly the states of Jalisco, Colima, and Michoacan. And I urge everyone along the Pacific coast to remain very vigilant,” said President Claudia Sheinbaum during her regular morning press conference.
In 2023, Acapulco suffered the fury of Hurricane Otis, considered the strongest tropical cyclone ever to make landfall on the Mexican Pacific coast. The storm, which struck in late October, left at least 68 confirmed deaths, according to Guerrero's state Attorney General's Office, and caused approximately $16 billion in damage, according to estimates from Mexican business associations.

items.title: As Trump and Xi meet, investors play both sides of AI divide
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: As China and the US race to build separate AI supply chains, investors are playing both sides, with US banks fundraising for AI upstarts in China and Chinese money flowing to US tech.
items.body:
As China and the US race to build separate AI supply chains, investors are playing both sides, with US banks fundraising for AI upstarts in China and Chinese money flowing to US tech.
The stakes are sizable, with Wall Street banks acting as bookrunners on 19 Chinese high-tech equity capital market deals worth $17.2 billion so far this year, according to LSEG data, accounting for nearly 30% of the sector's total issuance.
US stocks, particularly semiconductors, are also the [USN:L4N4560L0 TEXT:"favourite destination"] for China's outbound mutual funds. The value of US equity held by Hong Kong residents and mainland Chinese has jumped 23% in the past year to top $750 billion, US data shows.
The financial connections, shown in public disclosures, enmesh the competitors in a rivalry analysts say is akin to the Cold War Space race. AI is likely to be [USN:L6N45815R TEXT:"in focus"] when leaders Donald Trump and Xi Jinping meet this week in Washington.
For investors, the mutual exposure is a safety net giving both sides an interest in keeping relations steady, and holding expectations low for the [USN:L8N45A068 TEXT:"Trump-Xi meeting"] to break new ground.
It is also at risk of unwinding painfully if US-China relations deteriorate and further cleave AI development in two.
"US and Chinese businesses and investors continue to maintain connectivity and invest in each other despite highly volatile geopolitical conditions," said Fred Hu, founder and chairman of private equity firm Primavera Capital Group.
"The forthcoming Trump-Xi Summit can hopefully inject more certainty and energy to the essential financial connectivity and broader economic relationship."
US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said he and Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng discussed setting up a [USN:L6N45D021 TEXT:"US-China AI dialogue"] this week, with a notification system for common goals and threats.
FINANCIAL CONNECTIONS The financial connectivity has held and deepened despite China's pursuit of AI [USN:L1N44V0AA TEXT:"self-sufficiency"] and the US [USN:L6N44C06P TEXT:"Pax Silica"] initiative, aimed at securing its AI supply lines.
Washington restricts the supply of top-line chips and chip-making technology to China and has restricted U.S. investment into sensitive AI-related sectors in China for several years.
But the investing rules contain a [USN:L1N3M40UM TEXT:"carve-out for publicly-traded securities"] and have not stopped Wall Street's involvement in China's AI listing boom, where investor interest is fuelled in part by China' self-sufficiency drive.
Wall Street banks this year advised on more than a dozen AI and chip listings and follow-on share sales, LSEG data showed.
Wall Street underwriting Chinese tech IPOs is about "clipping the ticket on both sides of a cold war," said James Buckley-Thorp, founder and CEO of AI company Atlian.
Optical parts maker Zhongji Innolight , which raised $6.8 billion in a major listing in Hong Kong, counted Goldman Sachs (GS.N) , Morgan Stanley (MS.N) and Citigroup (C.N) among its joint global coordinators.
Goldman and Morgan Stanley also worked on Hong Kong listings of AI developer MiniMax (0100.HK) , chipmakers Montage Technology and Shanghai Iluvatar CoreX Semiconductor (9903.HK) , while J.P. Morgan (JPM.N) underwrote the roughly $2.6 billion Hong Kong share sale by Victory Giant Technology , which makes printed circuit boards for AI servers.
US banks also show up in shareholder registers of chipmakers on Shanghai's Nasdaq-like STAR Market, holdings that typically reflect activity on behalf of clients and suggest they are conduits for global cash into the sector.
From investors' point of view, US technology restrictions could help, rather than hinder development and interest in China's domestic tech players, said Atlian's Buckley-Thorp.
"There'll be two internets, two chip stacks, two rulebooks, and your portfolio needs a passport for both," he said.
"The Shanghai punter buying Nvidia and the pension fund buying Zhipu in Hong Kong are making the same bet: that the politicians won't actually pull the trigger. That's the trade," he said, referring to the risk of politicians taking a harder line on AI.
CAPITAL IS PROFIT SEEKING Where it can be tracked, Chinese investment flow to the US has also been strong.
U.S. stocks, and tech shares among them, account for nearly half of the 1 trillion yuan ($150 billion) managed by China's outbound mutual funds, which invest under quotas controlled by China's foreign exchange regulator.
The value of Chinese holdings jumped this year in US chipmakers including Micron Technology (MU.O) , AMD (AMD.O) , Sandisk Corp , Lam Research (LRCX.O) and Applied Materials (AMAT.O) , according to data compiled by Sinolink Securities.
According to S&P Global Market Intelligence, the total value of US AI funding rounds involving investors based in China or Hong Kong has climbed sharply from about $436 million in 2023 to roughly $8.9 billion through mid-September.
To be sure, the flows are shifting and there are frictions close to the surface.
Thilo Hanemann, a partner at research firm Rhodium Group, said wealthy Chinese investors continue to invest in US tech companies through offshore funds, "but there is very limited visibility into these fund structures and thus the magnitude of exposure."
At least one U.S. lawmaker has [USN:L1N3TL13G TEXT:"criticised"] JPMorgan Chase and Bank of America for underwriting the Hong Kong listing of Chinese battery giant Contemporary Amperex Technology Co , a company the U.S. says has ties to China’s military.
JPM in an email reply said: "We recognize the challenges posed by geopolitics. As global and Chinese companies continue to engage and compete across markets, we operate within applicable legal, regulatory, and risk-management frameworks."
Washington is also adding a growing number of Chinese tech companies to its list of companies it believes are aiding Beijing's military. And SpaceX's website and IPO materials were inaccessible in Hong Kong and mainland China ahead of its listing in June.
Still, investors on either side of the so-called 'Silicon Curtain' want to spread their bets, for now.
"There probably won't be a single winner in the U.S.-China AI race," said Xile He, a China-born-and-educated entrepreneur who's co-founder and CEO of AI start-up BrentX in San Francisco.
"From an investor perspective, I think betting entirely on one side is a big risk."
($1 = 6.6963 Chinese yuan renminbi)

items.title: ソフトバンクGのジャンク債、初期需要200億ドル超集める－関係者
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： ソフトバンクグループが計画する社債発行に対し、200億ドル（約3兆1500億円）を超える初期需要が集まっていることがわかった。事情に詳しい関係者が明らかにした。OpenAIへの投資資金の調達を支えるための起債で、過去最大級のジャンク債発行となる可能性があり、投資家は記録的な高利回りが提示されると見込み、買いに動いている。

関係者によると、この潜在的な需要は投資家が示した初期段階の拘束力のない購入意向を反映したもので、24日に予定されている発行条件の決定を前に、需要を測る最初の目安となる。

別の関係者は21日、ソフトバンクが今回の起債で、100億ドルのドル建て債と10億ユーロ（約1800億円）のユーロ建て債を発行し、合計で110億ドル超相当の調達を目指していると明らかにした。発行規模に上限はなく、最終決定はまだ下されていないという。

ソフトバンクの担当者は、問い合わせに対し「今回の起債では100億ドルのドル建て債と10億ユーロのユーロ建て債を提示した。非常に多くの需要があり、起債は極めて順調に進んでいる。発行規模に関するそれ以外の情報は、現時点では全くの臆測であり、発行額を増やす計画はない」と電子メールで回答した。

孫正義最高経営責任者（CEO）率いるソフトバンクグループは、OpenAIに650億ドル近く投資する方針を示しており、その他のAI分野と合わせ、世界最大級のAI投資家となっている。AIがもたらす可能性とリスクが、世界の市場で大きな変動要因となる中、ソフトバンクのジャンク債発行は、AIに対する投資家心理を測る大きな試金石となる。

事情に詳しい別の関係者によると、ソフトバンクと主幹事銀行は、今回の起債で想定される発行条件について投資家の意向を探っていた。ドル建て債で最も年限の長い7.5年債は利回り約10%、ユーロ建て債で最も年限の長い6年債は、利回り8%台半ばで検討されている。

items.title: 中国のテンセント、AI画像生成モデル投入－字節跳動やアリババを追撃
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary:
（ブルームバーグ）： 中国のテンセント・ホールディングス（騰訊）は、競合するアリババグループがAIカンファレンスを開幕したのと同じ日に、最新かつ最高性能の画像生成モデルを投入した。字節跳動（バイトダンス）など業界大手への追い上げを図る姿勢を示した。

「Hy Image 3.5
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 中国のテンセント・ホールディングス（騰訊）は、競合するアリババグループがAIカンファレンスを開幕したのと同じ日に、最新かつ最高性能の画像生成モデルを投入した。字節跳動（バイトダンス）など業界大手への追い上げを図る姿勢を示した。

「Hy Image 3.5 Preview」は前世代モデルから性能が向上しており、チャットボットの「元宝（Yuanbao）」や映像編集、デザインツールなどテンセントの各種製品への統合が進められている。同社が22日の発表文で明らかにした。

今回の投入は、テンセントがテキスト以外の用途の開拓を加速していることを示す。同社は、微信（ウィーチャット）のエコシステムを利用する10億人超のユーザーに代わってタスクを実行するAIの構築という構想の実現を目指している。

米メタ・プラットフォームズのエージェント機能を中心とする「Muse（ミューズ）」は今月の提供開始から間もなく、モバイルアプリストアのダウンロードランキングで首位に急浮上した。ユーザー向けにコンテンツを個別最適化し、買い物や配車依頼などのタスク遂行を支援できるエージェント型AIへの関心の高さを浮き彫りにした。香港市場でテンセント株は7%超上昇した。

オールスプリング・グローバル・インベストメンツのポートフォリオマネジャー、ゲーリー・タン氏は「一部の投資家はテンセントとメタの類似性に注目している。特に独自のソーシャル・エコシステムと、大規模にパーソナルAIアシスタントを展開できる可能性が背景にある」と述べた。

テンセントは、社内の数百人のデザイナーを対象にHy Image 3.5 Previewをテストし、バイトダンスの「Seedream 5.0 Pro」と同等の結果を達成したと説明した。新たなHy Imageモデルは、アルファベット傘下グーグルの「Nano Banana Pro」やアリババの「Qwen-Image-3.0 Pro」をわずかに上回るとも主張した。

items.body:
カナダ、比・ＡＳＥＡＮとのＦＴＡ交渉が9割超完了＝貿易相
9/22 17:19 配信

カナダのシドゥ国際貿易相。２５年１１月ニューデリーで撮影（２０２６年　ロイター/Anushree Fadnavis）

[マニラ ２２日 ロイター] - カナダのシドゥ国際貿易相は２２日、フィリピンおよび東南アジア諸国連合（ＡＳＥＡＮ）とそれぞれ進めている自由貿易協定（ＦＴＡ）交渉が９０％以上完了したと明らかにした。カナダ政府はカーニー首相が１１月にマニラを訪問するまでに、両協定をまとめたい考えだ。

シドゥ氏はマニラで開かれた東南アジア経済相会合に合わせてロイターのインタビューに応じ、「双方に合意への意欲があり、それが何より重要だ」と述べた。

「相手国の動向にかかわらず、多角化は常に最優先の方針だった」と説明した。東南アジアとの関係強化は「特定の１カ国を念頭に置いたものではない」とし、米国の通商政策の変化が主な動機でもないと述べた。

東南アジア諸国が燃料調達先の多角化を進め、地政学的な混乱の影響を回避しようとする中、カナダは液化天然ガス（ＬＮＧ）輸出能力を拡大していると述べた。カナダの太平洋岸では、開発段階の異なる５件以上のＬＮＧ事業が進んでおり、いずれもアジア市場への供給を目指しているという。

「カナダはエネルギー価格の安定と供給網の強化に重要な役割を果たせる」と語った。

また、カナダはフィリピンの主要製造業拠点「ルソン経済回廊」への資金支援を約束しており、エネルギーやデータセンター、関連インフラに投資機会があるとみていると説明した。人工知能（ＡＩ）やデジタルサービスの需要が増す中、フィリピンで成長するデータセンター分野への参入機会も探っていると話した。

items.title: Novo CEO says pills could capture 50% of weight-loss market by 2030
items.summary: By Patrick Wingrove LONDON, Sept 22 - Weight-loss pills could capture as much as half of the global obesity drug market by 2030, Novo Nordisk's chief executive told Reuters ...
items.body:
Novo CEO says pills could capture 50% of weight-loss market by 2030
Reuters | Updated: 22-09-2026 20:43 IST | Created: 22-09-2026 20:43 IST

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

By Patrick Wingrove LONDON, Sept 22 - Weight-loss pills could capture as much as half of the global obesity drug market by 2030, Novo Nordisk's chief executive told Reuters on Tuesday, as the Danish drugmaker positions itself for a shift away from weekly injections.
CEO Mike Doustdar said Novo was preparing for a market in which pills play a much larger role. The company has five oral treatments in development after beating rival Eli Lilly to market with the first obesity pill earlier this year. Doustdar told Reuters after Novo's Capital Markets Day in London that competitors remained heavily focused on injectables, which still dominate the market, a dynamic he said could favour Novo over the longer term.
"What happens if by 2030 the market is 50/50 (pills-to-injectables)?" he said, noting that rivals' pipelines contain eight injectables for every two pills under development. "We are preparing ourselves for all scenarios, including that one." CHANGING FORTUNES
If realised, that split would exceed Wall Street forecasts, which expect oral treatments to account for about 14% to 40% of an obesity market projected to reach between $100 billion and $150 billion by 2030. Novo's fortunes have reversed sharply since the 2021 launch of its Wegovy weight-loss medication helped make it Europe's most valuable listed company. Its shares have tumbled more than 70% from their peak as Lilly has overtaken its market share.
The company has found some relief in its Wegovy pill. Oral therapies now account for about a third of US obesity prescriptions following the pill's rollout, according to company presentations on Monday, with Novo capturing more than 80% of new oral prescriptions. The pill generated nearly 5.5 billion Danish crowns ($843 million) in first-half sales.
Novo's oral obesity pipeline includes next-generation dual-acting tablet zenagamtide, an oral amylin analogue and a small-molecule drug. Doustdar added oral Wegovy was protected from generic competition into the "mid and late 30s" through patents covering its SNAC delivery technology, addressing investor concerns over a patent cliff when active ingredient semaglutide loses exclusivity in the early 2030s.

items.title: UK's Burnham wants to work with EU on 'Made in Europe' plan
items.author: Elizabeth Piper, Alistair Smout
items.creator: Elizabeth Piper, Alistair Smout
items.summary: Prime Minister Andy Burnham said he would argue for Britain to be a "trusted partner" to the European Union's "Made in Europe" scheme, saying they should not be pitted as enemies on a policy that has the potential to hammer the UK's car industry.
items.body:
Prime Minister Andy Burnham said he would argue for Britain to be a "trusted partner" to the European Union's "Made in Europe" scheme, saying they should not be pitted as enemies on a policy that has the potential to hammer the UK's car industry.
The [USN:L8N42K09E TEXT:"Made in Europe policy"] aims to curb reliance on Chinese components by prioritising European-made goods – a worry for the British auto industry which feeds parts into EU supply chains and sells cars across the bloc.
Travelling to New York for his first United Nations General Assembly as prime minister, Burnham told reporters he believed there was support for Britain to have access to the scheme.
"Europe's argument is not with us. We both suffer the same effects as other countries, particularly steel," he said on the flight to New York on Monday, where he is expected to meet European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen.
Britain has argued that the "Made in Europe" plan could impact supply chains and create unnecessary trade barriers between it and some member countries, with Burnham urging the two sides to avoid further "collateral damage".
He is also anxious not to miss out on another scheme after talks to join the [USN:S8N3WQ06W TEXT:"EU's SAFE defence fund broke down"].
"We are making the argument: we are not your enemies here... we are not the problem," Burnham said of the scheme. "Let's work towards a trusted partner approach that doesn't cause a problem where there wasn't a problem and where we have common cause."
CAR TRADE WORTH €80 BILLION French junior industry minister Sebastien Martin said that while the EU could consider enhanced economic co-operation with some partners, a country could not leave the bloc as Britain did and "expect exactly the same rights as those enjoyed from within".
"That does not preclude an intelligent dialogue with our British friends — given the close, integrated value chains linking the European continent and the United Kingdom," he told reporters on the sidelines of a conference about Made in Europe.
"But our discussions will take place on the basis of the Europe of the 27 (EU members)."
The Society of Motor Manufacturers and Traders on Tuesday said Britain's exclusion from the EU's proposed "Made in Europe" provisions would put its automotive industry in jeopardy and threaten its contribution to the EU's economy.
The SMMT said the UK-EU trading relationship in the sector was worth €80 billion a year, and interdependence in supply chains meant that carmakers in Europe would also be damaged if Britain was excluded from the policy.
SMMT Chief Executive Mike Hawes said it would be an own goal, "weakening competitiveness, reducing scale and limiting consumer choice".
Asked about the SMMT's warning, a government spokesperson said there would be discussions to "find solutions that benefit the industry across the continent".
Britain's uncertain status within the scheme is just the latest area of contention since it voted to quit the EU in 2016.
For supporters of Brexit, a Britain outside the EU would be free to trade with faster growing countries around the world.
But since then, the advance of China, the unpredictability of Donald Trump's US and rapid technological innovation have put that decision into sharper relief.
Burnham has said he wants to deepen relations with the EU after his predecessor Keir Starmer reset ties following years of distrust. A UK-EU summit was delayed by that change in leader in July, but London hopes it will take place this year.

items.title: Anthropic, OpenAI call for Australia to relax ban on training of AI models
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Top AI companies OpenAI and Anthropic urged Australia to rethink a ban on letting them use the country's creative content for training their models, saying a limited exemption could protect artists' rights while encouraging more investment.
items.body:
Top AI companies OpenAI and Anthropic urged Australia to rethink a ban on letting them use the country's creative content for training their models, saying a limited exemption could protect artists' rights while encouraging more investment.
Countries around the world are scrambling to settle on how to regulate the explosion of AI while courting investment that economists say may be worth hundreds of billions of dollars by the end of the decade.
Australia has said it will implement a broad set of rules on AI and data centres to take effect from next year, but has already ruled out an exemption to copyright laws which effectively prevents the mostly US-domiciled companies from undertaking training there.
In submissions to a parliamentary inquiry in September on laws governing AI, the companies acknowledged the ban, but called for it to be relaxed.
"Anthropic accepts that broad exceptions from copyright ... have not received widespread support and have been ruled out by the government," said the owner of AI chatbot Claude in its submission.
"As an alternative, we believe that the government could permit AI model training through a narrow form of conditional approval," it added.
If Australia required "investment or other conditions designed to support the future of Australian creators and cultural endeavours ... we are open to considering those conditions," it said.
ChatGPT maker OpenAI called for "a balanced copyright framework that allows models to learn from publicly available information" while offering rightsholders opportunities to collaborate.
Both companies tied the issue to major infrastructure investments underway in Australia, with OpenAI having signed an offtake agreement with Australian data centre developer NextDC (NXT.AX) for a planned data centre in Sydney and Anthropic named last week as a partner for a data centre in [USN:L1N458029 TEXT:"Queensland."]
The submissions add to pressure on the government as it weighs the interests of AI developers against those of authors, publishers and other creators, who have resisted exemptions allowing their work to be used to train commercial models without consent or payment.
The Joint Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence is due to deliver its report in November.
items.raw_description: Top AI companies OpenAI and Anthropic urged Australia to rethink a ban on letting them use the country's creative content for training their models, saying a limited exemption could protect artists' rights while encouraging more investment.

items.title: FMI confirma apertura de oficina en Caracas, Venezuela, para el primer semestre de 2027
items.summary: La oficina será parte del proceso de acercamiento del organismo a Venezuela, después de años de aislamiento y tras la reanudación formal de sus relaciones con el FMI.
items.body: Bloomberg — La directora gerente del Fondo Monetario Internacional, Kristalina Georgieva, dijo que el organismo abrirá una oficina en Caracas el próximo año, confirmando los planes para una presencia permanente en Venezuela a medida que profundiza su relación con el país. “Sucederá”, declaró Georgieva a Bloomberg News al salir de una reunión con la presidenta interina Delcy Rodríguez en Nueva York el lunes. La oficina podría abrir sus puertas “en algún momento del primer semestre del próximo año”, añadió. Ver más: HRW alerta que la apertura política en Venezuela no será sostenible sin desmantelar el aparato represivo Sus declaraciones constituyen la confirmación más clara hasta el momento de los planes del organismo financiero con sede en Washington para establecer una presencia local en Venezuela, tras meses de conversaciones con funcionarios. Bloomberg News informó previamente que el FMI estaba considerando abrir una oficina a medida que intensifica su asistencia técnica después de que Venezuela comenzara a compartir más datos económicos con el Fondo. Esta medida se produce unos cinco meses después de que Venezuela retomara formalmente sus relaciones con el FMI bajo la administración interina de Rodríguez, quien tomó el control del gobierno venezolano después de que las fuerzas estadounidenses capturaran a Nicolás Maduro. Tras años de aislamiento, altos funcionarios del FMI viajaron a Caracas a finales de julio por primera vez en más de dos décadas, seguidos de una misión más amplia del personal del FMI. Ver más: Exxon negocia su regreso a Venezuela: de la expropiación de 2007 a un nuevo acuerdo “Ahora nos estamos asegurando de ponernos al día rápidamente con los datos y las políticas monetarias y fiscales clave”, dijo Georgieva. Rodríguez llegó a Nueva York a primera hora del lunes para asistir a la Asamblea General de las Naciones Unidas. También se reunió con representantes del Banco Interamericano de Desarrollo y del Banco Mundial, en un momento en que Venezuela busca restablecer sus lazos con las instituciones financieras internacionales. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.author: ロイター

items.summary:
Andy Bruce

[マンチェスター（英国） ２２日 ロイター] - 英国立統計局（ＯＮＳ）が２２日発表した８月の公...
items.body:
英8月財政赤字、予想上回る　累計赤字もＯＢＲ予測を超過
9/22 16:17 配信

英コヴェントリーの製造技術センターで演説を行うヒーリー財務相。7日代表撮影

Andy Bruce

[マンチェスター（英国） ２２日 ロイター] - 英国立統計局（ＯＮＳ）が２２日発表した８月の公的部門純借入額は１８３億ポンド（２４５億ドル）となり、ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想の１５５億ポンドを上回った。初の予算案発表を控えるヒーリー財務相にとって厳しい状況となっている。

ＯＮＳはまた、２０２６／２７年度の過去４カ月の借入額をそれぞれ上方修正し、４─８月の累計赤字は７７３億ポンドとなった。前年同期を２２億ポンド下回ったものの、予算責任局（ＯＢＲ）の予測を８１億ポンド上回った。

ＯＮＳの統計担当者は税収は好調に見えたものの、政府の物品・サービスへの支出や、インフレに連動する社会保障給付の増加によって相殺されたと説明した。

投資収支を除いた財政収支の赤字は、４─８月の累計で５１９億ポンドと、ＯＢＲ予測の４７１億ポンドを上回った。政府は２９／３０年度にこの収支を均衡させる必要がある。

前年度に当たる２５／２６年度の借入額は４５億ポンド上方修正され、１３４３億ポンドとなった。

レイノルズ財務相は統計を受け、政府は「不確実性に備えた余裕」を確保しつつ財政ルールを守る方針だと改めて表明した。

経済調査会社ＩＴＥＭクラブのチーフ経済アドバイザー、マット・スワネル氏は「中期的な借り入れの見通しは３月時点よりはるかに厳しくなっている」と述べた。

「ＯＢＲが春に予測を公表して以降、英国債利回りが上昇したことで、ヒーリー氏の財政上の裁量余地は半減した。政府の主要な財政ルールを守るための余裕は１００億ポンド強しか残っていない」と指摘した。この余裕は３月時点で２４０億ポンド超あった。

items.summary: According to CNN, internal discussions surrounding a potential sideline meeting at UNGA have focused on whether a dialogue would meaningfully advance the administration’s efforts to establish a path ...
items.body:
Trump willing to meet Iranian delegation in New York "if conditions are right": Report According to CNN, internal discussions surrounding a potential sideline meeting at UNGA have focused on whether a dialogue would meaningfully advance the administration’s efforts to establish a path toward ending the US war with Iran.
ANI | Updated: 22-09-2026 19:40 IST | Created: 22-09-2026 19:40 IST

US President Donald Trump (File Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

US President Donald Trump has expressed interest to his advisers in setting up a meeting with Iranian officials present in New York for the UN General Assembly's 81st session, “if the conditions are right." Citing a US official familiar with the matter, CNN reported that the official noted any potential meeting might instead involve some of the president’s top advisers travelling with him in New York, though no formal encounter has been scheduled yet.
According to CNN, internal discussions surrounding a potential sideline meeting at UNGA have focused on whether a dialogue would meaningfully advance the administration’s efforts to establish a path toward ending the US war with Iran. Furthermore, the official told CNN that there is scepticism over whether the Iranian diplomats in New York possess the backing of Tehran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei, who is considered the final authority on such matters.
The official also informed CNN that it remains uncertain whether Iranian officials would even be willing to meet. Iran’s scaled-down delegation currently in the US for the UN General Assembly includes Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and President Masoud Pezeshkian.
Both Secretary of State Marco Rubio and US Ambassador to the UN Mike Waltz have indicated that the president remains “open” to engaging with the Iranian representatives. Waltz told CNN’s Kaitlan Collins on Wednesday that Trump “is always open” to discussions, adding: “That’s a question I wish you could ask the Iranians is, will they sit down directly with us? And who is speaking for the ayatollah? That’s been a continuous issue.”
Additionally, when questioned regarding whether Trump intended to interface with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian in New York, Rubio noted that Washington remains receptive to the concept, though no formal schedule has been established. "We’re open to that. I don’t think anything is scheduled at this point, but we’re certainly open to something like that, especially if it has the prospects of leading to something positive," Rubio said in an interview with US broadcaster NBC.
Rubio additionally reaffirmed Washington’s stance concerning Iran’s nuclear programme, emphasising that the primary aim of any diplomatic engagement focuses on guaranteeing Tehran never obtains a nuclear weapon. "And that is the fact that Iran can never have a nuclear weapon. They just simply can’t," Rubio said.
Nevertheless, neither Washington nor Tehran has verified that a face-to-face meeting between the two presidents has been arranged. The potential for a Trump-Pezeshkian meeting unfolds while the nearly seven-month-old US-Iran conflict persists without resolution, accompanied by continuous warnings from both sides.
In remarks reported on Monday, Trump conveyed that Iran faced choices including "wiping Iran out," allowing its economy to "rot" or reaching a deal. He further remarked that he remained in "deciding mode" regarding Washington's next steps. "My question is, if and when do I blow the entire nation up," Trump said. "They better behave."
Simultaneously, Iranian officials have warned that any fresh US military action could lead to a broader conflict. Hossein Mohebbi, spokesperson for Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, asserted that Tehran would alter both its weapons and the geographical scope of the conflict if Washington launched another attack.
"If a new aggression takes place, we will definitely change the weapons and geography of the war," Mohebbi said, according to Iran’s semi-official Fars news agency. With both Trump and Pezeshkian expected in New York for the UN General Assembly, the gathering provides a potential setting for direct contact between Washington and Tehran. (ANI)

items.body:
中国の海外信託課税、個別株にリスクも＝ＢｏｆＡ証券
9/22 16:00 配信

写真は中国・北京の海底撈（ハイディラオ）火鍋レストラン。２０２１年１０月撮影。REUTERS/Tingshu Wang

Summer Zhen

[香港 ２２日 ロイター] - ＢｏｆＡ証券によると、香港や米国に上場する多くの中国企業の株主が採用してきた人気の仕組みである海外信託（オフショアトラスト）に対して所得税を課す新たな規則を中国が導入したことで、納税期限が近づく中、一部の銘柄に短期的なリスクが生じる可能性がある。

• ＢｏｆＡ証券の中国株式ストラテジスト、ウィニー・ウー氏は香港での記者会見でロイターに対し、オフショアに上場する民間企業への監視が強まる可能性がある一方、国有企業への影響は比較的小さいとみられると述べた。

• 中国当局は７月、海外信託に置かれた資産とそこから生じる所得に個人所得税を課すと表明した。未納の税金は９０日以内に納付しなければならず、その期限が今、近づいている。

• 中国の火鍋チェーン、海底撈（ハイディラオ）の主要株主は今月、２億５９００万株を予想外に売却し、２７億５０００万香港ドル（３億５０５９万米ドル）を現金化した。それ以降、同社の株価は１７％下落しており、納税が一部のオフショア中国株に与える影響を巡り市場の懸念が高まっている。

• ウー氏は「このオフショア税の期限は１０月２２日で、実際の影響を見極めるまで約１カ月の猶予がある」と指摘した。

• ロイターはこれまでに、弁護士やアドバイザーの話として、今回の取り締まりにより、中国の富裕層が信託の構造や投資資産の保有形態の見直しを迫られていると報じていた。

items.title: Trump, Greenland, Denmark sign deal in bid to end Arctic standoff
items.author: Gram Slattery, Jacob Grønholt-Pedersen
items.creator: Gram Slattery, Jacob Grønholt-Pedersen
items.summary: US President Donald Trump and the leaders of Greenland and Denmark signed an agreement on Tuesday that permits a larger US military presence on Greenland and may resolve a standoff over the strategically located and mineral-rich island.
items.body:
US President Donald Trump and the leaders of Greenland and Denmark signed an agreement on Tuesday that permits a [USN:L1N45D0X6 TEXT:"larger US military presence"] on Greenland and may resolve [USN:L1N45D06G TEXT:"a standoff"] over the strategically located and mineral-rich island.
The agreement, signed during Trump's visit to the UN General Assembly in New York, stops short of Trump's demand that the US annex Greenland as a US territory to head off the growing Arctic presence of Russia and China.
But the deal does codify a greater US military presence on the icy territory, an option that emerged as Greenland leaders argued against a complete US takeover.
A text of the deal released after the event said the US can establish a "Golden Dome" defense system in Greenland as a shield against ballistic missile threats. The shortest route from Europe to North America runs via the Arctic island, which is the location of the northernmost US military base.
In his speech to the assembled world leaders at the UN before the signing ceremony, Trump said the agreement gives the US "permanent control over security and all other needs on that territory."
"No US adversary will ever be permitted to establish a military presence in Greenland any more, or make sensitive investments there without our express written approval," Trump said.
Trump signed the agreement along with Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen and Greenland Prime Minister Jens-Frederik Nielsen in a trilateral ceremony after Trump gave his UN speech.
Frederiksen described the agreement as a deal that can "last forever" and said it underlines the importance of the NATO alliance and respects Greenland's right to self-determination.
A STRONG NATO Nielsen emphasized the importance of NATO in the Arctic region. "We believe that it is vital to keep NATO strong, also in the Arctic, where the alliance has a key role to play," he said.
At a press conference after the signing, Nielsen said Greenlanders must now go through a process of restoring trust with the US. Trump's threats to take the island by force had strained relations with both Greenland and Denmark.
"I believe the crisis is over now, but I don't think the conflict is over in the sense that this agreement could very well be used - if the Americans wish - as a platform to force through further concessions," said Mikkel Vedby Rasmussen, a political science professor at the University of Copenhagen.
Greenland, a former colony and now a semi-autonomous territory of the Kingdom of Denmark, sits between the Arctic and North America and holds vast energy resources.
The US already operates Pituffik Space Base in remote northwestern Greenland. The deal opens [USN:L1N45D0X6 TEXT:"two new military sites"]: Narsarsuaq, a former Cold War airbase whose population has dwindled to just a few dozen, and Mestersvig, currently used by the Sirius Dog Sled Patrol, a Danish special forces unit.
"We will immediately begin the process of developing a large military presence in the appropriate location. We will be building two very major military bases," Trump said in his UN speech.
Trump's refusal to rule out military or economic force to acquire Greenland triggered a diplomatic crisis in January within NATO and forced Denmark and the island's government into months of intensive negotiations.
The text of the agreement says it amends a 1951 defense treaty that had been the legal basis for the US presence.
It adds that Washington may seek further bases in the future, with details decided by mutual agreement. The deal has no end date, grants US aircraft and vessels broad access across Greenland and its territorial waters, and bars non-NATO states from establishing military installations on the island.
It also restricts foreign investment, effectively blocking states and investors from countries outside NATO, NATO partners and the European Union from holding control or significant influence in sectors deemed particularly sensitive, including critical infrastructure and resource extraction.
The deal, which needs approval by the parliaments of Denmark and Greenland, marks a shift from Trump's earlier ambitions for an outright acquisition of Greenland, an island three times the size of Texas with a population of only 57,000 scattered along its rugged coastline.
But it represents the first major increase in US military infrastructure in Greenland since the Cold War, when the US maintained 17 installations and more than 10,000 personnel there.

items.title: 新たなエネルギーショックでインフレ高止まり-ECBチーフエコノミスト
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 欧州中央銀行（ECB）のチーフエコノミストを務めるレーン理事は22日のスイス紙ル・タンとのインタビューで、エネルギー価格の新たな上昇局面を受け、ユーロ圏のインフレ率は当初予想していたより長期間、高止まりするとの見通しを示した。

レーン氏はその中で、「現在、原油だけでなくガスでも第2波の価格上昇が見られる」と指摘。「この第2波のエネルギー価格上昇は一段と高く、一層持続的なインフレにつながると考えられ、その後、2027年半ば以降はわれわれの目標に向けて鈍化すると予想している」と語った。

レーン氏は「現在目の当たりにしている第2波のエネルギー価格上昇は食品価格や、電力を含む広い意味でのエネルギー価格、物品価格全般に上昇圧力を及ぼすだろう」と述べる一方、「サービス価格への圧力は抑制された状態が続くだろう」と話した。

イランでの戦争を受けてエネルギーコストが急騰して以降、2回目の利上げを今月実施したECBでは、当局者がすでに追加利上げに向けた地ならしを始めている。10月にも0.25ポイントの追加の引き上げに踏み切る可能性がある。

ユーロ圏のインフレ率は今後数カ月で約4%に上昇すると予想されている。ECBの最新予測では、今年の平均が3%、来年が2.5%と見込まれており、いずれも2%の目標を大幅に上回る。一方、経済は引き続き底堅さを示している。

レーン氏は「この秋、ショックが一段と強く長期化すれば、経済の重荷になるだろう」としつつも、「ショックがそれほど深刻でなければ、欧州の一部で実施されている大規模な公的支出など、幾つかのプラス要因が成長を支えるだろう」と指摘。特にドイツのインフラ・防衛投資プログラムや、欧州連合（EU）の復興基金（NextGenerationEU）に言及した。

レーン氏はまた、「AI関連の活動の中心は欧州にはないものの、この分野で事業を展開する企業は十分にあり、欧州経済も恩恵を受けることができる」とした上で、「われわれの基本シナリオでは、エネルギーショックが激化しない限り、欧州経済は安定的で、緩やかなペースで成長を続けるとみている」と説明した。

items.title: China’s CXMT advances DRAM with G5 platform; Eyes strategic move into NAND flash
items.summary: China’s ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) commenced commercial output on its fifth-generation platform, consolidating its market position against entrenched global competitors Samsung Electronics, ...
items.body:
China’s CXMT advances DRAM with G5 platform; Eyes strategic move into NAND flash China’s ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) commenced commercial output on its fifth-generation platform, consolidating its market position against entrenched global competitors Samsung Electronics, SK hynix, and Micron, according to a news report by The Korea Herald.
ANI | Updated: 22-09-2026 19:07 IST | Created: 22-09-2026 19:07 IST

China’s CXMT starts small-scale HBM3E production (Photo/CXMT). Image Credit: ANI

Country:

South Korea

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

China’s ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) commenced commercial output on its fifth-generation platform, consolidating its market position against entrenched global competitors Samsung Electronics, SK hynix, and Micron, according to a news report by The Korea Herald. The Chinese semiconductor firm also prepares an experimental research facility in Beijing to evaluate an expansion into NAND flash memory, according to a news report by The Korea Herald.
CXMT confirmed that its G5 architecture entered volume production alongside two 24-gigabit LPDDR5X components intended for portable hardware and smartphones. Dynamic random-access memory provides real-time workspace for processors, serving as an essential building block across personal computers, enterprise servers, and mobile devices. The chipmaker reported that the new platform delivers at least 50 per cent more gross dies per wafer compared to its previous process on an 8-gigabit-equivalent standard. Gross die count reflects the aggregate quantity of potential chips extracted from a single wafer before defect screening, rather than an outright gain in production yields.
The manufacturing rollout follows CXMT’s rise to fourth place globally in the DRAM sector, capturing 9.5 per cent of second-quarter revenue, according to TrendForce data cited in the report. Market leader Samsung held 39.4 per cent, followed by SK hynix at 24.9 per cent and Micron at 23.3 per cent. Through quadruple patterning techniques, CXMT narrowed the active-area half-pitch in its memory array to 11.95 nanometers, a metric specific to internal array layout that does not directly match node designations used by competitors.
Assessing the competitive landscape during an industry webinar in August, TechInsights Vice President and memory-chip analyst Choi Jung-dong noted the gap between CXMT and dominant fabricators. “CXMT is about two generations behind the industry leaders,” the news report quoted Choi.
He added, “but it is steadily advancing its HBM roadmap toward higher-performance memory solutions.” As market leaders allocate manufacturing capacity toward server memory and high-bandwidth memory for artificial intelligence acceleration, standard DRAM availability remains constrained, offering smaller producers openings to secure orders.
CXMT is now assessing the NAND segment, where stored information persists without continuous electric power, powering storage drives and mobile devices. Domestic rival Yangtze Memory Technologies leads China’s current NAND output. Reuters reported that CXMT’s Beijing NAND research line remains in exploratory phases, with the company holding preliminary discussions with prospective buyers while commercial timelines remain undetermined. TrendForce figures place Samsung atop the second-quarter NAND sector with 29.3 per cent revenue share, ahead of SK hynix Group at 18.2 per cent.
Analyzing broader dynamics, an industry official highlighted the pressure building against dominant Korean manufacturers. “Chinese memory makers still have a clear cost disadvantage to their Korean rivals, but tight supply has given them more room to win orders and expand production,” the news report quoted an industry official.
The official added, “If the current upcycle lasts, competition from both Chinese and US suppliers, backed by heavy government support, will become harder for the Korean companies to ignore.” (ANI)

items.body:
ＡＩ搭載ノートＰＣ「グーグルブック」予約開始、899ドルから
9/22 15:30 配信

写真はグーグルのロゴ。昨年５月撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

[２１日 ロイター] - 米アルファベット傘下のグーグルは２１日、スマートフォンの基本ソフト（ＯＳ）「アンドロイド」と連動する新たなプレミアムノートパソコン（ＰＣ）「グーグルブック」の予約受け付けを開始した。人工知能（ＡＩ）ツール「ジェミニ」を中核に据えた製品だ。

価格は８９９ドルから。エイサー、エイスース、デル、ＨＰ、レノボの初期モデルは、インテルまたはクアルコムのプロセッサーを搭載し、バッテリー駆動時間は最大１４時間になるという。

今回の製品投入は、アップルが６９９ドルの「ＭａｃＢｏｏｋ　Ｎｅｏ（マックブックネオ） 」で低価格ノートＰＣ市場への進出を強める中で行われた。この市場では、グーグルのＰＣ用ＯＳ「クロームＯＳ」を搭載した「クロームブック」のメーカーが長年、手ごろな価格とシンプルさを武器に学生や節約志向の消費者をターゲットにしてきたが、競争が激化している。

グーグルブックは、より高性能なハードウエア、ＡＩ機能、アンドロイドとのより緊密な統合を通じて、こうした戦略をプレミアムノートＰＣに広げるものだ。

製品群には、文章の作成・整理を支援したり、画面上のコンテンツに関する質問に答えたり、アンドロイドスマートフォンで行っていた作業を引き継いだりできるジェミニのツールが含まれる。

アンドロイドの技術基盤に、クロームＯＳのデスクトップ向け基盤を組み合わせて構築されており、スマートフォンとパソコンの間の切り替えをよりシームレスにすることを目指している。

items.summary: ［２１日　ロイター］ - フィリピンの複合企業アヤラ・コーポレーションは２１日、三菱商事が４４５億フィリピンペソ（７...
items.body:
三菱商事、フィリピン複合企業アヤラに追加出資　議決権ベースで20％
9/22 14:48 配信

都内で2017年8月撮影　 REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon/File Photo

［２１日　ロイター］ - フィリピンの複合企業アヤラ・コーポレーションは２１日、三菱商事が４４５億フィリピンペソ（７億０９４８万ドル）追加出資すると発表した。出資比率は現在の４．７％から３倍超の１５％に、議決権ベースでは２０％に上がり、三菱商事のフィリピン事業基盤が一段と強化される。

１株当たりの株式取得価格は６５０ペソと、直近終値に対して約２２％のプレミアムを乗せた水準。

三菱商事は、消費者向け事業での協力を深めるほか、アヤラの中核事業である不動産とエネルギーの分野で機会を追求する方針を示した。２０２６年度中の取引完了を見込む。

アヤラは、スマートフォン決済アプリ最大手「Ｇキャッシュ」を運営するミントに傘下通信会社を通じて資本参加する。ミントは先週、フィリピン証券取引所への上場申請が承認された。資金調達額は最大１４億７０００万ドル規模と、フィリピン最大の新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）になる可能性がある。

items.title: Russia kills eight in strikes on Ukraine as Trump meets Zelenskiy
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Russia killed eight people in strikes on Ukraine's industrial heartland and other frontline areas, Ukrainian officials said on Tuesday as President Volodymyr Zelenskiy was meeting US President Donald Trump at the United Nations.
items.body:
Russia killed eight people in strikes on Ukraine's industrial heartland and other frontline areas, Ukrainian officials said on Tuesday as President Volodymyr Zelenskiy was [USN:L8N45E0JN TEXT:"meeting US President Donald Trump"] at the United Nations .
Moscow stepped up airstrikes over the summer, and has been attacking economic targets ranging from businesses and ports to logistics hubs, with its advances on the ground largely stalled more than 4-1/2 years into its war in Ukraine .
"Russia deliberately targets businesses, farms, warehouses, railways, energy facilities and residential buildings," Ukrainian Prime Minister Sergii Koretskyi said on Telegram.
Ukraine has also increased long-range strikes in recent months, targeting Russian oil refineries and big online retailers in an effort to undermine Moscow's war effort.
The Ukrainian military said on Tuesday it had hit a Russian oil refinery in the city of Ufa, more than 1,300 km (800 miles) from the border with Ukraine. It also said it had struck the Kuibyshev oil refinery in the Samara region on the Volga river.
The Samara region governor said Ukrainian drones [USN:L8N45E08P TEXT:"hit civilian targets"] in the region, killing one person and injuring four. Both sides deny targeting civilians.
Trump said last week that Ukraine and Russia had agreed not to strike energy targets, but any semblance of a truce disappeared when Russia hit petrol stations in Kyiv the following day and Ukraine bombed a Russian oil refinery.
STRIKES ON THREE INDUSTRIAL CITIES Continuing attacks on Ukraine's economic infrastructure, Moscow hit industrial enterprises in the cities of Dnipro, Kryvyi Rih and Pavlohrad in the southeastern region of Dnipropetrovsk, regional governor Oleksandr Hanzha said on Telegram.
The region is home to machine building, steelmaking and other major production.
A Russian missile strike on a facility in Dnipro owned by Interpipe, Ukraine's largest pipe producer, killed four people and wounded seven, [USN:L8N45E0N7 TEXT:"the company said"].
Prosecutors said Russian attacks on the southern region of Kherson killed two people and the regional governor said one person was killed near the Black Sea port of Odesa.
Police in the eastern Donetsk region, the focal point of much of the frontline fighting, said Russian aerial bombs killed one person in Kramatorsk, one of the "fortress towns" that Russia would like to capture.
A mass airstrike on the town of Izium, in northeastern Kharkiv region, injured seven people, local officials said.
The overnight Russian barrage included an unspecified number of Oniks anti-ship and ballistic missiles, as well as four cruise missiles and 212 drones, Ukraine's air force said.
[USN:S8N44V08P TEXT:"Russia's defence ministry"] said its forces hit industrial and military facilities in Ukraine, targeting the fuel and energy sector as well as port infrastructure facilities and sea vessels serving the Ukrainian military.
OIL AND GAS FACILITY HIT Businesses were also damaged in Pavlohrad and Kryvyi Rih, Zelenskiy's hometown, Hanzha added.
A Russian attack on an energy facility in a neighbouring region cut power supplies to nearly 100,000 consumers in the northern region of Chernihiv, an electricity distributor said.
Ukrainian energy company Naftogaz said at least five ballistic missiles had hit idle technological facilities at an oil and gas site in the central region of Poltava. The attack caused critical damage and in effect made it impossible to restore and operate the facility, it said.
The facility, which it did not name, had been a frequent target of Russian drone and missile attacks since 2022, it said.

items.body:
ＥＣＢ、インフレの目標回帰は27年半ばから＝レーン専務理事
9/22 14:44 配信

写真は欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のチーフエコノミスト、レーン専務理事。ロンドンで６月撮影。REUTERS/Chris J. Ratcliffe

[チューリヒ ２２日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のチーフエコノミストであるフィリップ・レーン専務理事は、 地政学リスクが再び高まっているとみられ、原油・ガス価格を押し上げているエネルギーショックはＥＣＢが３月時点で想定していたよりも長期化する見通しだという認識を示した。２２日付のスイス紙ルタンが伝えた。

レーン氏は同紙に対し、「その結果、この第２波のエネルギー価格上昇は、より高く、より持続的なインフレをもたらすと考えている。インフレはその後、２０２７年半ばから（ＥＣＢの）目標に向けて低下していくだろう」と述べた。

電力やサービスなど他の物価への波及効果が見られるかとの質問には「これまでのところ、２月から現在に至るまで、そうした影響は見られておらず、朗報だ。しかし、現在見られているエネルギー価格上昇の第２波は、食品価格、電力を含むより広範なエネルギー価格、そして一般的なモノの価格に上昇圧力をかける可能性が高い。対照的に、サービス価格への圧力は比較的抑制された状態が続く見込みだ」と語った。

items.title: Zelenskiy says he discussed energy truce, efforts to end Russia war with Trump
items.author: Tom Balmforth
items.creator: Tom Balmforth
items.summary: Ukrainian leader Volodymyr Zelenskiy said on Tuesday he discussed with US President Donald Trump efforts to end the 4-year-old war with Russia, including a potential bilateral ceasefire on energy-related targets.
items.body:
Ukrainian leader Volodymyr Zelenskiy said on Tuesday he discussed with US President Donald Trump efforts to end the 4-year-old war with Russia, including a potential bilateral ceasefire on energy-related targets.
Speaking to the media after a 40-minute meeting with Trump at UN headquarters in New York, Zelenskiy said Kyiv was ready for any format of an energy ceasefire with Moscow, but there had been no discussion of Ukraine unilaterally halting its attacks on Russian oil refineries.
Trump, whose approval ratings have [USN:L6N45D0XN TEXT:"slumped to a record low"] amid high gas prices ahead of the US midterm elections in November, had expressed concern in recent days over the extensive damage done to Russia's fuel-processing capacity, which he said was stoking diesel prices globally.
Zelenskiy reiterated that he was ready to meet Russian President Vladimir Putin at a trilateral meeting with Trump, adding that he hoped the US would find a way to bring Moscow back to the negotiating table after talks unravelled earlier this year.
Zelenskiy, however, said he had seen no indication that Putin was ready to talk.
"I'm ready for a trilateral meeting. It means that I'm agreed to end the war," Zelenskiy said.
Before their meeting, Trump told reporters that he and Zelenskiy would discuss Ukrainian attacks on oil refineries.
"It is a serious hit on the Russians. It's also a serious hit on the price of diesel," said Trump.
He said he and Zelenskiy would also talk about solutions for ending the war, which began with Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022.
"I think it's going to happen," Trump said.
The US leader announced last week that Ukraine and Russia had agreed not to strike energy targets, but any semblance of a truce disappeared when Russia hit petrol stations in Kyiv the following day and Ukraine bombed a Russian oil refinery.
Zelenskiy also met with UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham, who said he lobbied Trump to press for a Ukraine-Russia energy ceasefire in his meeting with his Ukrainian counterpart. Burnham also promised further financial support to Kyiv for infrastructure.
AERIAL ATTACKS Intensifying aerial attacks by both sides in the Ukraine war in recent weeks have battered ports, warehouses, ships and energy infrastructure, as well as crippling Black Sea grain exports.
Amid fears in Ukraine that Russia will once again pound its heating and power facilities as winter approaches, Zelenskiy said he had discussed preparations with Trump and asked the US for a package of Patriot air defence missiles — the only weapon in Ukraine's arsenal capable of downing Russia's ballistic missiles.
The US war in Iran and the Ukraine war have depleted global supplies of Patriots, including US inventories.
Zelenskiy said that, in return for Patriots from US stockpiles this winter, Ukraine would swap future supplies of interceptors from its deal with Germany, which has agreed to provide Ukraine with 600 Patriots in 2027 and 2028.
He told reporters it was a "good step" that the idea was not rejected but acknowledged that Trump had not yet agreed to the proposal.
Zelenskiy said that discussions for Ukraine to begin licensed production of Patriots itself were still ongoing, and a member of his team had held a positive meeting with Raytheon (RTX.N) , a US producer of Patriots.

items.title: Princess Diana's brother, eyewitness to history, sparks royal ruckus
items.author: Sarah Young
items.creator: Sarah Young
items.summary: Charles Spencer said he wrote a book about his sister because it was his duty "as an eyewitness to history", but his version of events has been rejected by Buckingham Palace in unusually strong terms.
items.body:
Charles Spencer, brother of the late Princess Diana, is no stranger to writing books about British kings.
His previous bestsellers include "Killers of the King" and "To Catch a King" and, while those two works focused on the 17th century, some might say his [USN:L8N45D1MQ TEXT:"latest book"] is along the same lines.
"Swan Song: Diana, My Sister" will be published on Tuesday, and is his take on his sister's life and her unhappy marriage to the now King Charles. In [USN:L8N45D0VU TEXT:"pre-released excerpts"], Spencer claims Charles was "giddily elated" in the aftermath of Diana's death in 1997, reopening a painful episode for the royal family.
Spencer, 62, said he wrote the book because it was his duty "as an eyewitness to history", but his version of events has been rejected by Buckingham Palace in [USN:L8N4581JE TEXT:"unusually strong terms"].
"The pain of fraternal grief can cloud reason, affect judgment and colour memory," it said, in a statement that added to the publicity surrounding the book.
GODSON TO QUEEN ELIZABETH Spencer was born into a British aristocratic family, with close links to the royal family. The late Queen Elizabeth was his godmother.
He was 17 when his 20-year-old sister, fast becoming the most photographed woman in the world, married the then-Prince Charles in a fairytale wedding in 1981. Spencer told CNN in an interview some years later how at the time he was more interested in "exams and playing my sports at school" than the global event.
The wider world, however, was fascinated by the young couple, who went on to have two sons, William in 1982 and Harry two years later. But behind the scenes, the relationship unravelled.
"I didn't fully understand actually how very difficult things were for her at times," Spencer told Good Morning America in an interview before the book was released.
"That's one of my regrets. I wish I could have done more to help her."
By the early 1990s, Diana's unhappiness was making headlines across the world, and she and Charles were using the media to brief against each other. They divorced in 1996.
A year later, she was killed, aged 36, in a Paris car accident as she was pursued by photographers. Spencer used a much-lauded eulogy at her funeral to tell an estimated 2 billion people watching around the world that her "particular brand of magic" meant she would "never be extinguished from our minds".
His words were applauded by the tens of thousands of people who listened on loudspeakers in the streets of London, but some of his comments about how Diana's goodness was "threatening" and how her "blood family" would need to protect her sons, made uncomfortable listening for the royal family.
'ASTONISHINGLY PROVOCATIVE' Whatever goodwill between the two families remained after Diana's death will likely have been lost after Spencer's new allegations about King Charles, which have reignited talk about one of the most damaging periods in the [USN:L8N45D0O1 TEXT:"royal family's modern history"].
He writes that Charles said of Diana "we'll forget her soon enough", before shouting at Spencer for suggesting the then 15-year-old William and 12-year-old Harry, should not be expected to walk behind her coffin at the funeral.
Spencer, who has seven children from three different wives and married his fourth wife earlier this year, hit back at Buckingham Palace's questioning of his memory.
"It was astonishingly provocative and below the belt because it was essentially trying to say I'd lied without the King being able to deny what I'd said," he told the Daily Mail.
After studying history at the University of Oxford in the early 1980s, Spencer worked for US broadcaster NBC News for a decade, presenting lifestyle and travel programmes.
He inherited the family's 30-bedroom ancestral mansion in central England in 1992, when his father died, and started writing history books in the late 1990s, one of which was shortlisted for an award and many of which were top sellers.
His publishing career has helped pay for the restoration of the Althorp estate, which has been in his family for five centuries and where Diana is buried.
In 2024, he published a memoir, "A Very Private School", that detailed his experience of sexual abuse, neglect and isolation while at boarding school as a child.
"When looking at the wreckage of my first and second marriages, I learned early in therapy that being sent away to boarding school at eight years of age meant that I had next to no understanding of intimacy," he writes in that book.

写真はアリババと「Ｑｗｅｎ」のロゴ。２０２５年１月撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

[北京 ２２日 ロイター] - 中国アリババグループは２２日、パラメーター数が５兆から１０兆に上る新たな人工知能（ＡＩ）モデルを訓練する計画を明らかにした。また、ＡＩモデル、半導体、データセンターを網羅する包括的な戦略を打ち出した。

呉泳銘最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は杭州で開かれたアリババ・クラウドの年次イベントで講演し、同社のＡＩモデル「Ｑｗｅｎ（通義千問）」のチームが「より複雑で長期的なタスク」を完遂し「人工超知能（ＡＳＩ）」に向けて前進することを目標に、モデルアーキテクチャーとデータ最適化の研究を継続していると述べた。

同社は別の声明で、次世代モデル「Ｑｗｅｎ４」を現在訓練中で、その後の「Ｑｗｅｎ４．５」および「Ｑｗｅｎ５」シリーズはパラメーター数を５兆から１０兆規模まで拡大する見通しだとした。 

パラメーターはモデルが訓練中に学習する変数で、モデルの規模を大まかに示す指標となる。

アリババの現行主力モデル「Ｑｗｅｎ３．８Ｍａｘ」のパラメーター数は２兆４０００億で、計画中のモデルはこの２─４倍の規模となる。

呉氏はアリババ独自のＡＩスーパーノード「Ｍ８９０」が既に２兆パラメーターを超えるモデルの推論を処理できると述べ、この能力を持つのは「世界でも一握りの企業」だけだとした。

ＡＩ自身がモデルを改善する「再帰的自己改善」においてＱｗｅｎチームが「有意義な進展」を遂げたとも述べた。

アリババはまた、半導体子会社Ｔ－Ｈｅａｄ（平頭哥）が手がける次世代ＡＩ半導体「Ｚｈｅｎｗｕ　Ｖ９００」を発表した。呉氏は同製品が中国で最も強力なＡＩチップだとし、前世代の「Ｍ８９０」の３倍の性能を発揮すると述べた。

Ｖ９００は２０２７年第１・四半期に量産・商用化の予定という。Ｍ８９０は今年５月にリリースされていた。

呉氏は、年間のＡＩ半導体出荷量に「大幅な成長」が見込まれると述べた。

呉氏はアリババ・クラウドの世界データセンター容量を３２年までに２０ギガワット超に拡大する目標も打ち出した。顧客のＡＩ需要は「極めて堅調」で、クラウド事業の収益成長を加速させていると述べた。ただ、ＡＩデータセンターのサプライチェーン全体で世界的な供給不足が生じており、拡大ペースが制約されていることを認めた。

items.title: 仏ソジェン新3カ年計画、ＲＯＴＥ13─14％　ＡＩでコスト削減拡大
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Tommy Reggiori Wilkes　Elizabeth Howcroft

［ロンドン／パリ　２１日　ロイター］...
items.body:
仏ソジェン新3カ年計画、ＲＯＴＥ13─14％　ＡＩでコスト削減拡大
9/22 13:42 配信

ナントで2022年2月撮影　REUTERS/Stephane Mahe

Tommy Reggiori Wilkes　Elizabeth Howcroft

［ロンドン／パリ　２１日　ロイター］ - フランス金融大手ソシエテ・ジェネラル（ソジェン）は２１日、２０２９年までの新たな３カ年戦略計画を発表した。主要な業績目標を引き上げるとともに、追加のコスト削減を実施するとした。

ソジェンは高コスト体質と低い収益性が長年、業績の重しとなってきた。２３年に就任したスラウォミール・クルパ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は体質改善による立て直しを表明。同年９月に発表した３カ年計画は成果を上げ始めている。

クルパ氏はロンドンで投資家向けに新計画を説明し、「コスト削減は従来から、そして今後も当行の戦略の中核であり続ける」と述べた。

新計画では、２９年の有形株主資本利益率（ＲＯＴＥ）目標を１３─１４％とし、今年の約１１％から引き上げる。３０年以降は１５％到達を目指す。現在の水準は同業他社の大半を下回る。

配当と自社株買いを通じた株主還元方針は変更しない。目標を達成した場合、ソジェンは２０２６─２９年の４年間に最大２１０億ユーロを株主に還元する可能性がある。

＜ＡＩでコスト削減を後押し＞

２９年までに１９億ユーロのコスト削減を目指す。調達・情報技術（ＩＴ）関連の支出削減、人工知能（ＡＩ）による生産性向上、人員削減を通じ、総コストを２６年水準から２％減の１６３億ユーロ（１８７億ドル）未満に抑える。

２９年の経費率を５５％未満とし、従来目標の６０％からさらなる抑制を目指す。

＜プライムブローカレッジとリテールで増収狙う＞

最大部門の投資銀行は、米銀が市場シェアを伸ばす中で、ここ数四半期、業績が振るわない状況となっている。

グローバル・マーケッツ部門の２９年収入は６０億─６５億ユーロと予想。これは前年の６０億ユーロとあまり変わらない。

クルパ氏は、ヘッジファンド向け業務やプライムブローカレッジ、金融スポンサーへの助言業務で収益を増やす大きな機会があるとの見方を示した。

フランス国内のリテール銀行業ではレボリュートなどのデジタル銀行が事業を拡大している。ソジェンはデジタル銀行「ブルソバンク」について、現在９００万人の顧客数を２９年までに１４００万人に増やす計画。

またブルソバンクとリテール部門を単一の経営体制に統合する。ブルソバンクは顧客のあらゆる資産水準に対応し、支店網を多く抱えるリテール部門は「マス富裕層」に重点を置く。

＜金利動向注視＞

ソジェンの業績はこの２年間、金利上昇が欧州の銀行全体の利益を押し上げる中で改善した。ただ金利上昇は最終的に銀行の資金調達コストを押し上げる可能性がある。ソジェンをはじめとするフランス金融各社は、世界的な債券売りとフランスの財政持続可能性への懸念を背景に他の先進国市場より速いペースで上昇しているフランス国債利回りの動向を注視している。

クルパ氏は、ソジェンは向こう２─３年にわたりヘッジをかけており、影響は重大なものにならないと述べた。

アナリストは、新たな目標は予想をやや上回り、特にコスト面で強い内容だったと評価した。

ジェフリーズは年平均３％の増収目標は「やや控えめだ」と指摘した上で、「今回の計画の優れた点は、経営陣がコストの推移を明確に把握し、コスト構造に関して非常に個別性の高い施策を打ち出していることだ」と述べた。

ＪＰモルガンのアナリストは、資金調達・助言業務の売上高見通しが従来を上回っていることから、ソジェンの見通しはより強気だと指摘した。

items.title: アリババが新型AI半導体投入、中国で｢最も強力｣－エヌビディアに対抗
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 中国のアリババグループは、同国で最も強力だとするAI向け半導体の投入を進めている。米半導体大手エヌビディアに対抗するアクセラレーターで、今後数年にわたるデータセンター能力の大規模な拡張を支える狙いだ。

電子商取引大手からAI企業への転換を目指すアリババは22日、前世代の3倍の性能を持つとする新型アクセラレーター「真武（Zhenwu）V900」の概要を明らかにした。同社の半導体部門Tヘッドが開発したもので、最大50万基を連結して最先端モデルの学習に活用できると呉泳銘（エディー・ウー）最高経営責任者（CEO）は述べた。

アリババは中国の主要企業の中でもAIへの投資額が最大級の企業だ。AI能力の拡充に向け、3年間で530億ドル（約8兆3470億円）超を投じる方針を示しており、8月には香港での追加の新株発行で約102億ドルを調達した。

ウー氏は22日、より時間を要する複雑なタスクに対応するため、5兆－10兆個のパラメーターを持つモデルを開発する計画を明らかにした。これは現時点で一般的なモデルをはるかに上回る。

さらに、アリババ・クラウドについて、世界のデータセンター能力を2032年までに20ギガワットとする目標をウー氏は提示。この大規模な拡張によって、急成長する同部門の外部顧客からの売上高は1600億ドルを超える可能性があるとシティグループは試算している。

ウー氏の発言に先立ち、米メタ・プラットフォームズの新たなパーソナルAIエージェントに初期段階で成功の兆しが見られ、投資家の楽観論が再燃していた。香港市場ではアリババ株が一時5%超上昇し、微信（ウィーチャット）を運営するテンセント・ホールディングス（騰訊）の株価は7%超急伸した。

ウー氏は「昨年、われわれはAIの能力が高まれば高まるほど、人類もより強力になると論じた」とし、「現在も、その確信は揺るがない」と語った。

原題：Alibaba Unveils AI Chip to Drive Global Data Center Buildout (2)（抜粋）

[フランクフルト ２１日 ロイター] - ドイツの主要経済研究機関が同国の今年と来年の経済成長率見通しを上方修正した。独紙ハンデルスブラットが２１日報じた。

同紙が関係者の話として伝えたところによると、２０２６年の成長率見通しは１．３％と、従来の０．６％から引き上げられた。

２７年の予想は１．１％で、従来の０．９％から上方修正された。

最新の予想はライプニッツ経済研究所（ＲＷＩ）、Ｉｆｏ経済研究所、キール世界経済研究所（ＩｆＷ）、ハレ経済研究所（ＩＷＨ）、ドイツ経済研究所（ＤＩＷ）が共同でまとめた。

SEOUL: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung has urged the United States to ease sanctions on North Korea in exchange for an agreement under which Pyongyang would freeze its nuclear weapons programme, the New York Times reported.
"I believe there is significant value in a trade-off between sanctions - which are not particularly effective anyway - and a stop to the development of additional nuclear weapons and intercontinental ballistic missile technology," the newspaper quoted Lee as saying in an interview.
Lee also said that pursuing denuclearisation under the current circumstances meant that nothing would be accomplished. 
Once a nuclear weapons freeze was secured, trust could be built through reciprocal incentives and concessions to eventually convince North Korea to reduce its nuclear arsenal, he said.

The current stalemate was simply too risky to be allowed to continue, Lee said, citing South Korean assessments that North Korea was now capable of producing, or may already be producing, an additional 10 to 20 nuclear weapons each year.
"Once it believes it has accumulated enough nuclear weapons and missiles to guarantee its survival, it will be tempted to export them to make money," he said. "That will be a truly dangerous moment."

Related:

North Korea fires unidentified projectile into East Sea: Seoul

South Korean officials have said that they are moving away from a "denuclearisation first" policy in favour of a "peace first" approach towards North Korea, with Lee pledging last year to respect North Korea's system and seek peaceful coexistence with Pyongyang.
Relations between the Koreas remain frozen, however. North Korean leader Kim Jong Un has abandoned Pyongyang's reunification policy, describing the South as its most hostile state and ordering stronger frontline defences.
United States President Donald Trump is seeking to hold a new meeting with Kim, and the South Korean president has said that he is keen to see the talks happen.
Lee intends to present his vision for peace and coexistence on the Korean Peninsula to the United Nations this week during the UN General Assembly.

items.summary: Australia's corporate watchdog has warned it could take action against "poor practices" by firms in the booming private credit sector, from unrealistic valuations to opaque fees, if standards do not improve.
items.body:
Australia's corporate watchdog has warned it could take action against "poor practices" by firms in the booming private credit sector, from unrealistic valuations to opaque fees, if standards do not improve.
The sector's rapid growth and complexity have outpaced industry standards, a commissioner of the Australian Securities and Investments Commission (ASIC) said, saying the [USN:L1N44M01W TEXT:"recent collapse"] of property developer Bathla was not surprising.
"The clock is ticking," Commissioner Simone Constant said in a speech in Sydney on Tuesday. "Whether we see broader credit stress or not, certainly the tide is going out on poor private credit practices."
She added, "We're now beyond warnings. The sector should prepare for enforcement action."
The comments come after 18 months of [USN:L1N42P06U TEXT:"stepped-up scrutiny"] by ASIC of the industry. The regulator was also surveilling wholesale and retail funds as it pursued enforcement investigations, she added.
"We continue to see issues around valuations, liquidity, governance, conflicts and transparency."
The regulator estimates Australia's private credit sector to be worth about A$200 billion ($142 billion). It is heavily exposed to real estate lending, making up about 40% to 60% of the market.
Such lending was vulnerable to inflation, cost increases, project delays and unrealistic asset valuations, Constant said.
As a result, fund managers must make difficult decisions when loans deteriorate, she added, rather than "protecting fees or appearance".
Bathla owed A$3 billion to more than 40 lenders when it entered administration, a debt burden [USN:L4N45807L TEXT:"administrators said"] appeared to be a significant contributor to its failure.
"The collapse of Bathla reinforces why strong governance, effective oversight, clear disclosure and accurate valuations are critical," Constant said.
($1=A$1.4073)

North Korea reports new missile test designed to give enemy ‘incurable headache’

By Heejin Kim
SEOUL, Sept 22 (Reuters) – North Korea said it successfully tested a new weapon showcasing “ultra-modern defence technology” on Sunday, in a launch overseen by leader Kim Jong Un, who praised progress in strengthening the country’s war readiness, state media reported on Tuesday. 

Kim said the test, conducted by North Korea’s Missile Administration, demonstrated a significant development in the country’s armed forces’ ability to fight and “the enemy will know better what such progress means without any explanation.”

“He affirmed that such reality would give the enemy an incurable headache and a very cruel and unavoidable blow,” Kim was cited as saying.

Show Full Article

The KCNA report did not specify the type of weapon tested. 

Photographs released by KCNA showed Kim, accompanied by his teenage daughter, inspecting a screen displaying a map of the country’s east coast and the “flight trajectory” of Hwasongpho-11-ma-1, which is likely part of a series of short-range ballistic missiles being upgraded by Pyongyang.

NK News, a Seoul-based website specialising in North Korea, said the projectile appeared to be an upgraded variant of a missile equipped with a hypersonic glide vehicle.

Mounting a glide vehicle on a missile means the warhead can manoeuvre to evade anti-missile defences and also potentially be launched partially into orbit.

Hypersonic missiles are among a range of weapons that Kim has called for development to upgrade its nuclear capabilities.

The South Korean military said on Sunday that North Korea fired two short-range ballistic missiles off its east coast.

The test came days after Pyongyang accused the US of raising tensions on the Korean Peninsula through a series of military drills.

On Monday, the foreign ministers of South Korea, Japan and the United States met on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York to agree to coordinate closely for peace, stability and denuclearisation on the Korean Peninsula, according to Seoul’s foreign ministry.

(Reporting by Heejin Kim, Minwoo Park, Jack Kim;Editing by Ed Davies)

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Joyce Lee　Heejin Kim

[ソウル ２２日 ロイター] - 韓国政府は、米国との３５００億ドル規模の投...
items.body:
韓国、対米投資第1弾はテキサス州ガス火力発電所　原発なども検討
9/22 11:44 配信

写真は韓国平沢市の港に並ぶ輸送コンテナ。昨年４月撮影。REUTERS/Kim Hong-Ji

Joyce Lee　Heejin Kim

[ソウル ２２日 ロイター] - 韓国政府は、米国との３５００億ドル規模の投資合意に基づき最初に進める事業として、テキサス州のガス火力発電所を選定した。他の２事業についても検討している。議員が２２日に明らかにした。 

金正官・産業通商資源相はこの日の非公開会合で議員らに計画について説明し、検討中の他の２事業についても詳細を共有した。

説明を受けた与党の議員は会合の合間に記者団に対し、テキサス州の発電所が最初に確定した事業だと述べた。韓国はこれと併せて、より広範な原子力投資事業の一環として、韓国が設計した「ＡＰＲ１４００」型原子炉２基への投資についても協議しているという。

同議員によると、米原子力技術企業ウエスチングハウスの株式５─１０％取得についても協議が行われている。一方、長らく延期されているアラスカの液化天然ガス（ＬＮＧ）プロジェクトへの参加については、まだ決定されていないという。 

今回の説明は、韓国製品に対する米国の関税を１５％に引き下げる貿易協定の履行に向けた最終調整を両国が進める中、重要な一歩となる。

議員らはこの説明を、両国が条件で合意して正式発表を行う前の最終段階の一つと位置づけている。 

韓国は昨年の貿易合意の一環として、韓国からの輸入品に対する関税引き下げと引き換えに、米国の製造業に投資することを約束した。

３５００億ドルのうち１５００億ドルは造船分野に充てられる。残る２０００億ドルの戦略投資の詳細はまだ確定していない。

メディアの報道と別の議員によると、テキサス州エンシナルの６．３ギガワットのガス火力発電所事業は２００億ドルを超える規模で、ＡＩ（人工知能）データセンターや半導体工場に電力を供給することを目的としている。

交渉に詳しい関係者によると、韓国と米国は米国内で最大８基の大型原子炉を建設することについても協議しており、うち２基は韓国のＡＰＲ１４００型、残る６基はウエスチングハウスのＡＰ１０００設計を採用する見通しという。 

また別の関係者によると、韓国は国内為替市場への影響を抑えるため、年間投資額に２００億ドルの上限を設けることを求めている。

South Korea’s Lee urges US to ease North Korea sanctions to freeze nuclear programs, NYT says

Reuters

22 September, 2026 08:00 am IST

Facebook

Twitter

WhatsApp

Linkedin

(c) Copyright Thomson Reuters 2026

Follow Us :

Text Size:
A-
A+

-->

SEOUL, Sept 22 (Reuters) – South Korean President Lee Jae Myung has urged the United States to ease sanctions on North Korea in exchange for an agreement under which Pyongyang would freeze its nuclear weapons programs, the New York Times reported.

“I believe there is significant value in a trade-off between sanctions — which are not particularly effective anyway — and a stop to the development of additional nuclear weapons and intercontinental ballistic missile technology,” the newspaper quoted Lee as saying in an interview.

Lee also said that pursuing denuclearization under the current circumstances meant that nothing would be accomplished. Once a nuclear weapons freeze was secured, trust could be built through reciprocal incentives and concessions to eventually convince North Korea to reduce its nuclear arsenal, he said.

Show Full Article

The current stalemate was simply too risky to be allowed to continue, Lee said, citing South Korean assessments that North Korea was now capable of producing, or may already be producing, an additional 10 to 20 nuclear weapons each year.

“Once it believes it has accumulated enough nuclear weapons and missiles to guarantee its survival, it will be tempted to export them to make money,” he said. “That will be a truly dangerous moment.”

South Korean officials have said that they are moving away from a “denuclearization first” policy in favour of a “peace first” approach towards North Korea, with Lee pledging last year to respect North Korea’s system and seek peaceful coexistence with Pyongyang.

Relations between the Koreas remain frozen, however. North Korean leader Kim Jong Un has abandoned Pyongyang’s reunification policy, describing the South as its most hostile state and ordering stronger frontline defences.

U.S. President Donald Trump is seeking to hold a new meeting with Kim and the South Korean president has said that he is keen to see the talks happen.

Lee intends to present his vision for peace and coexistence on the Korean Peninsula to the United Nations this week during the UN General Assembly.

(Reporting by Jack Kim and Brenda GohEditing by Ed Davies)

items.title: South Korea's Lee urges US to ease North Korea sanctions to freeze nuclear programs, NYT says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung has urged the United States to ease sanctions on North Korea in exchange for an agreement under which Pyongyang would freeze its nuclear weapons programs, the New York Times reported.
items.body:
South Korean President Lee Jae Myung has urged the United States to ease sanctions on North Korea in exchange for an agreement under which Pyongyang would freeze its nuclear weapons programs, the New York Times reported.
"I believe there is significant value in a trade-off between sanctions — which are not particularly effective anyway — and a stop to the development of additional nuclear weapons and intercontinental ballistic missile technology," the newspaper quoted Lee as saying in an interview.
Lee also said that pursuing denuclearization under the current circumstances meant that nothing would be accomplished. Once a nuclear weapons freeze was secured, trust could be built through reciprocal incentives and concessions to eventually convince North Korea to reduce its nuclear arsenal, he said.
The current stalemate was simply too risky to be allowed to continue, Lee said, citing South Korean assessments that North Korea was now capable of producing, or may already be producing, an additional 10 to 20 nuclear weapons each year.
"Once it believes it has accumulated enough nuclear weapons and missiles to guarantee its survival, it will be tempted to export them to make money," he said. "That will be a truly dangerous moment."
South Korean officials have said that they are moving away from a "denuclearization first" policy in favor of a "peace first" approach towards North Korea, with Lee pledging last year to respect North Korea's system and seek peaceful coexistence with Pyongyang.
Relations between the Koreas remain frozen, however. North Korean leader Kim Jong Un has abandoned Pyongyang's reunification policy, describing the South as its most hostile state and ordering stronger frontline defenses.
The U.S. State Department and White House did not respond to requests for comment on Lee's remarks to the newspaper.
U.S. President Donald Trump held unprecedented summits with Kim during his first term, but the diplomacy broke down over U.S. demands that North Korea give up its nuclear weapons. Trump is seeking a new meeting with the North Korean leader and the South Korean president is keen to see the talks happen.
In a speech to the U.N. General Assembly in New York on Tuesday, Lee reiterated support for a phased approach, saying efforts should begin with "a stop to further advances in North Korea's nuclear and missile capabilities," followed by reductions over the medium term and eventual denuclearization.
Lee urged a resumption of U.S.-North Korea talks and said "the most critical task" was to formally end the Korean War and establish a lasting peace regime on the peninsula.
"I hope the long-suspended dialogue between North Korea and the US can resume without delay," he said.
Lee said South Korea would pursue "inclusive, peaceful coexistence" with North Korea and pledged to respect its system, seek cooperation where possible and work to re-establish channels of communication and build trust.
Jenny Town of Washington's 38 North think tank, which focuses on North Korea, said Lee's sanctions proposal reflected recognition that North Korea's nuclear capabilities have advanced significantly since the last round of talks, making a phased approach more realistic.
"That means the price of any concessions on its nuclear program, if still possible, has gone up," she said.

フランス　高さおよそ100mでの綱渡り　逆さまで開脚も

TBSテレビ

2026年9月22日(火) 11:17

国際

数千人を釘付けにしたのは、世界遺産…ではなく、空中を歩く、人でした。

地面のはるか上、細いワイヤーを進む女性。

命綱は着けていません。

一歩ずつ慎重に進み、途中で逆さまになると、そのまま開脚や足を使ったぶら下がりも披露します。

ロイター通信によりますと、フランス北部で20日、綱渡り師の女性が地上からの高さおよそ100メートルでのパフォーマンスに挑戦しました。

そしてなんと、ワイヤーの長さはおよそ400メートル。

ここは、世界遺産にも登録されている歴史的な炭田地帯で、石炭を掘り出す際に出る残がいを積み上げてできた2つの山の間を繋いでいるといいます。

数千人の見物客が見守る中、女性はおよそ37分かけて無事に渡り切ったということです。

items.title: 米メタ発のAI株高が失速－投資家の慎重姿勢なお根強く
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米メタ・プラットフォームズのパーソナルAIエージェント「Muse（ミューズ）」の成功の兆しに端を発したAI関連株の大幅上昇は、22日に入り一服している。投資家は再び慎重姿勢に転じており、最近の相場変動により、上昇相場を追うことになお消極的であることが示された。

欧州や米国の時間外取引では半導体株の上昇が一服し、アジアでもサムスン電子やSKハイニックスなどが上げ幅を縮小した。21日には、フィラデルフィア証券取引所半導体株指数が4.3%急伸し、メタも11%高と、昨年10月以来の大幅な上昇となっていた。

パリのラ・フィナンシエール・ド・レシキエでトレーディング責任者を務めるデービッド・クルック氏は、「市場が昨日の上昇分を受けてやや調整するのは理にかなっているが、上昇基調は崩れていないとみている」と述べた。

欧州では、UBSグループの半導体銘柄のバスケットが、小幅な上昇と下落の間で推移している。米国の時間外取引ではエヌビディアが1%未満の下落となっている。アジアでは、韓国の半導体メーカー、サムスン電子とSKハイニックスが一時約3.5%高から上げ幅を縮小し、韓国総合株価指数（KOSPI）は0.2%高で取引を終えた。

相場が失速する中でも、中国のインターネット株はおおむね上昇を維持した。中国のテンセント・ホールディングス（騰訊）は、同社が微信（ウィーチャット）で同様のAI主導の事業機会を生み出せるとの期待から上昇した。同社はまた、最新かつ最高性能の画像生成モデルを投入したと発表した。

アリババグループも、中国で最も高性能だとするAI向け半導体を発表し、こうした楽観的なムードを一段と強めた。

ユニオンバンケールプリヴェ（UBP）のマネジングディレクター、ベイサーン・リン氏は「中国ハイテク株に注目が集まり、投資家の関心が北アジアの半導体株から離れつつある可能性がある」との見方を示した。また、「テンセントはMuseをきっかけとした上昇の恩恵を受けている一方、アリババは新たなAI半導体と大胆なデータセンター計画が支援材料となっている」と語った。

items.title: Binance faces US scrutiny over possible Iran sanctions violations, source says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: US prosecutors are investigating Binance in connection to US sanctions on Iran and trading activity on its platform, a source with knowledge of the matter said.
items.body:
US prosecutors are investigating Binance in connection to US sanctions on Iran and trading activity on its platform, a source with knowledge of the matter said.
The investigation is being led by federal prosecutors with the US attorney's office in Manhattan and with the Justice Department's criminal division in Washington, the source said. Bloomberg News, which earlier reported the probe, said investigators are scrutinizing whether Binance knowingly allowed the trading that violated the sanctions.
Spokespeople for the US Attorney's Office for the Southern District of New York and the Justice Department's criminal division declined to comment. Binance said in a statement it has a zero-tolerance approach to sanctions violations.
"We fully cooperate with law enforcement, and we remain committed to rooting out and shutting down bad actors," it said.
The US government has imposed [USN:L1N4520WY TEXT:"sanctions"] on firms and individuals it says are helping Hezbollah and other Iranian proxies in the Middle East, intensifying its campaign to isolate Iran economically.
Earlier this month, the US Attorney's Office for the Southern District of New York sought the forfeiture of millions of dollars in Iranian oil sales it said had been laundered on Binance's crypto exchange.
Binance has faced US scrutiny in the past. In 2023, Binance's then-chief Changpeng Zhao stepped down and pleaded guilty to breaking US anti-money laundering laws as part of a $4.3 billion settlement resolving a [USN:L1N3CM1MQ TEXT:"years-long probe"] into the world's largest crypto exchange. President Donald Trump later [USN:FWN3W42W4 TEXT:"pardoned the crypto executive"].

items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 大型連休（シルバーウイーク）中の22日の日本市場では、祝日取引が行われている株式先物が急伸した。米メタ・プラットフォームズの新しいAIエージェントが好調な滑り出しとなり、前日の米国株市場でテクノロジー株が高騰したことでAI関連企業の業績の先行きに楽観的な見方が広がった格好だ。

大阪取引所の日経平均先物12月限は、一時前営業日比2.9%高の6万6980円まで上げ幅を拡大した。午前11時時点では6万6600円台で推移。

メタの新AIエージェント「Muse（ミューズ）」が米国のモバイルアプリランキングで首位となり、競争が激しさを増す消費者向けAIアシスタント市場で同社が存在感を高めていることを示した。

これを受け、21日の米国株市場ではAIを支える半導体株が急伸。10%高と大きく上げたアドバンスト・マイクロ・デバイセズ（AMD）の時価総額は、初めて1兆ドル（約157兆4000億円）を突破した。インテルなども買われ、フィラデルフィア半導体株指数（SOX）は4.3%高で5営業日続伸となった。

キャピタル・ドット・コムのシニアアナリスト、カイル・ロッダ氏はメタがリリースした新AIチャットボットが強い需要を集めており、AI関連銘柄の成長見通しに対する楽観的な見方が再び高まっていると指摘。AI需要の堅調は「AIエコシステム、特に半導体分野の市場心理を改善させ、影響はアジアのハイテクセクターの一部にも波及するだろう」と述べた。

日経平均先物以外にも22日のアジア株式市場ではテック株の影響を受けやすい韓国総合株価指数（KOSPI）が一時2.3%高まで買われ、台湾の加権指数は一時1.8%高と日中ベースの最高値を更新した。

この他、米国とイランの戦争終結に向けた外交努力への期待で、国際原油市況が下落したことも金利高への不安を後退させた点で投資家心理にプラスに働いている。21日の北海ブレント先物は4営業日続落し、1バレル＝100ドル付近で終了した。

items.title: 米中、首脳会議を前にAIや投資を議論－NYでの2日目の協議終える
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米国と中国の当局者は21日、ニューヨークで2日目の協議を終えた。今週予定されている習近平国家主席の訪米を前に交渉を進展させることを目指し、AIや投資、貿易について協議した。

中国財政省の廖岷次官は、協議が行われたニューヨークのJPモルガン・チェース本社前で短く発言し、21日の話し合いでは米中双方の首席交渉官が合意した内容の履行にフォーカスしたと述べた。貿易休戦の延長を巡る協議について質問されたのに対し、廖氏はコメントしなかった。会場では、両国の他の高官の姿は確認されなかった。

ベッセント米財務長官、中国の何立峰副首相、李成鋼商務次官（国際貿易交渉代表）らは、20日に終日協議した。

李氏は20日の協議後、「良い雰囲気」で議論が行われたと述べ、ベッセント氏は「非常に成功した」と評価した。ベッセント氏は、米中両国がAI技術の恩恵と脅威について共通認識を形成することを目的とする「米中AI対話」と呼ぶ枠組みを設けることで合意したと話した。

貿易休戦が11月に期限を迎える中、焦点は米中が延長で合意できるか、合意した場合にどの程度の期間となるかだ。グリア米通商代表部（USTR）代表は21日、ブルームバーグテレビジョンとのインタビューで3－6カ月の延長は可能だと述べ、条件を協議する時間はまだあると語った。

トランプ米大統領と習氏は、貿易、レアアース（希土類）、AIなどの問題について協議すると予想されている。中国の税関統計によると、8月の中国から米国へのレアアース磁石の輸出は前月比21%減の512トンとなった。昨年の貿易休戦にもかかわらず、中国が重要鉱物の供給を引き続き絞っているとの懸念を浮き彫りにしている。

原題：China, US Discuss AI, Investment on Second Day of Trade Talks（抜粋）

items.title: OpenAI、米国に取り組みの主導求める－AIの国際基準策定で
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米OpenAIは、最先端のAIの国際基準策定に向け、米国が他国・地域と連携して取り組みを主導するよう求めている。AIがもたらす可能性のある弊害への懸念の高まりに対応する。

OpenAIは21日のブログ投稿で、AIを安全に開発するには国際的な技術基準が必要だと指摘。特に、AIモデルに関連するどのような事案を報告対象とすべきかを定義し、AIの進歩に向けて各国・地域がどう協力できるかを定め、こうした技術の開発に必要なコンピューティング能力へのアクセスを改善する上で重要だとした。

OpenAIは「AIの継続的な進歩を安全で有益なものにするには、アラインメント（人間の意図や価値観に沿わせる）研究の進展と、研究機関や国をまたいだ開発の指針となる共通基準の両方が必要になる」としている。

同社によると、サム・アルトマン最高経営責任者（CEO）は23日、国連安全保障理事会でAIと国際安全保障について演説する予定で、24日には中国の習近平国家主席を迎えてホワイトハウスで開かれる国賓夕食会に出席する。

OpenAIはブログ投稿で、こうした取り組みには各国が協力し、最も高性能なAIモデルの開発に向けて相互に補完し合う国内基準と国際基準を策定することを含むべきだと強調。同社は、米商務省内の組織で、AIモデルの試験や指針策定を支援するAI標準・イノベーションセンター（CAISI）など、各国に既に設置されているAI安全機関を通じて実現できるとの考えを示した。

ブログではまた、AIが自律的に作業を遂行する能力が高まっていることに対応するための基準も必要だと訴えた。人間の介入なしにAIが最終的に自らのコードを変更したり、その他の方法で能力を向上させたりできるようになるという理論を指す「完全自律型」の「再帰的自己改善（RSI）」について、「安全に実行できるようになるまでは」追求すべきではないとした。
